jd_text:
About us
Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
Who you’ll work with
BCN Customer COE, as part of Bain’s expert client delivery network, has the vision to lend expertise, speed and competitiveness to Bain’s Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Marketing & Customer Experience projects by co-developing and delivering Pricing products, designing Go-to-Market strategy solutions and improving customer experience effectively through client-specific analysis and solutions. We develop products and deliver solutions that help clients identify and fulfill their full potential across the entire sales value chain and customer journey. We also capture value across all stages—from problem identification and solution design to implementation and capability transfer.
The CoE has fast-paced, dynamic environment with continuous innovation and learning. We offer multitude of professional development opportunities for those who like to problem-solve in an analytical environment. The COE provides a truly global experience with opportunity to work with Bain teams, experts and clients across the world in an inclusive, collaborative and fun-loving team culture along with global transfer opportunities.
What you’ll do
We are hyper-focused on developing and deploying solutions that help clients accelerate growth sustainably through their go-to-market engine and help them reach full potential growth – from market opportunity identification to coverage planning, pricing, account cadence to optimization of sales and marketing functions, among other levers.
This is an opportunity to drive the development and deployment of our suite of cutting-edge solutions that help clients realize untapped value in their existing go-to-market engine within days and weeks, supported by analysis of client data and benchmarks and define the roadmap for the next ~12-18 months of work for the client and the Bain case teams.
Associate (Commercial Excellence) is an expert on developing and deploying solutions on projects and leads a work-stream with support from analysts (as needed) end-to-end – from ideation to delivery and presentation, leading discussions with key internal and client stakeholders including Bain Partners, Directors, and Case teams. Usually an associate is staffed 100% on a project and works under the guidance of the COE Project Leader/ Manager, playing a key role in output delivery and client communication
Leads and executes key client delivery and analyses across identified GTM levers, from solution ideation, development and development, as needed and ensure timely, high quality, error-free analysis and output
Bring strong problem solving skills clubbed with specialised knowledge of various analytical tools and best practices to deploy them
Demonstrate logical thinking and apply sound business judgment to drive the overall output across every stage (from data gathering to final presentation)
Brainstorm with the BCN Project Leader/ Manager and Bain consulting/ specialist team on various aspects of a client project or new IP development
Drive conversations through data analysis to help drive insights through data analysis and story-lining the deliverable to prove/disprove hypotheses in the best interest of the client/project
Provide actionable feedback, coaching and mentoring to analysts (as needed) to address their professional development needs
About you

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. While all consultants develop specialized knowledge and a focused program as they progress with McKinsey, most are initially very broad in their focus, meaning they do not need specific industry or functional expertise to be successful. For consultants who join McKinsey as experienced professionals, this can mean building on previous knowledge or developing unique experience in an area that is completely new.
You’ll be working with McKinsey’s Operations practice in our Johannesburg office.
Our Operations practice assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges. Blending strategic thinking with hands-on practicality, our teams of consultants and experts work to develop and implement operational strategies that solve our clients' most critical problems.
When you join McKinsey, you are joining a firm whose culture is distinctive and inclusive. We will accelerate your development as a leader to create positive, enduring change in the world.

Who you will work with
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. jd_text:
About us
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
Who you will work with
This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Performance Improvement Centre of Expertise (PI CoE). The PI CoE plays a crucial role in assisting case teams in India and abroad with various cost reduction/optimization activities by offering a range of solutions, including Procurement (e.g., Spend cube, analytics, maturity assessment, vendor strategy), Zero-based budgeting (e.g., Cost visibility, Budgeting, Initiative tracking, client training), Supply Chain (e.g., Inventory Diagnostics, Inventory Optimization, Network Optimization, Manufacturing Diagnostics, Integrated Business Planning), as well as cost diagnostics (e.g., Value Calculator, Net Working Capital), savings, and PMI Analysis. The CoE conducts complex and advanced data analysis to analyze clients' data and generate critical insights to help achieve cost objectives. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and employ powerful, dynamic visualizations/charts on various platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to showcase our results. The PI CoE is also involved in the creation of critical intellectual property (IP) that is valuable for new performance improvement cases globally at Bain.
About you
Candidate should be a graduate/post-graduate with strong academic records and relevant experience in procurement, spend analysis, category management, cost transformation or performance improvement roles .
Procurement function, process, sourcing and Category specific experience is a Plus.
Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 3-5 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post-Graduate with high academic records having 1-3 years of relevant experience
Excellent analytical skills, communication skills (ability to deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders), team management and project management skills
Demonstrated ability to work with MS Excel and PowerPoint
Knowledge of visualization and tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, PowerBI (Python is a Plus)
Ability to deal with ambiguity, handle multiple tasks, dynamic case expectations and work in a team set up
Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
What you’ll do
Work on problem solving, work-planning, analytics, research, and overall content to generate business insights and implications, deliver cases & deliverables. Role often requires leading a team of 1-2 analysts/ Workstream, based on case requirement. You will also help in developing intellectual property (IP), go-to-market materials, pitch documents and publications. The position reports into a Manager.
Own end to end case delivery of Performance Improvement projects related to Procurement / Cost Transformation. This includes the following:
Assist case teams across Bain’s ecosystem to analyze the problem and deploy the most appropriate tool/solution.
Understand client’s data using P&L, ERP Systems, budgeting systems, supplier databases and purchase order systems to design the solution.
Deliver procurement solutions across multiple fronts including spend analytics, savings lever design, supplier analysis, strategic sourcing, savings initiative design, among others.

Utilize appropriate research sources and analytical tools to identify and employ relevant data-driven insights for effective decision-making.
Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract information.
Communicate data, knowledge, and clearly explain insights and implications for the client to the entire team.
Effectively communicate with BCN leadership/case teams/end clients and manage relationships.
Demonstrate a strong ability to quickly grasp various business domains, conducting research and analysis across diverse geographies and industries with agility and efficiency.
Engage and ideate in developing new products/IP
Deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
Lead individual project work streams with the help of 1-2 directly aligned team members (analysts)
Willing to groom a team of analysts and support them as and when required.
What makes us a great place to work
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents..

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
Imagine a role that builds on your academic and personal capabilities, providing the most interesting business challenges and the opportunity to tackle them with the brightest and most supportive peer group. A role where you’ll make an impact from day one and be set on a global career path that will maximize your future career potential.
We have a long tradition of solving the most challenging problems with notable industry leaders and our consultants are the linchpins of this success. If you’re an ambitious individual who enjoys working with the brightest, most curious minds then we’d love you to join our team.

As a Bain consultant, your analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management and leadership skills will be called upon from day one. You will be in the thick of the action as you work side-by-side with some of the best in the business. And you will help create change.
Every day is different but a sample of the things you can expect to accomplish include:
Research the client organization and industry; interview, conduct focus groups and facilitate workshops with client employees, management teams and other stakeholders

Move the client to action; develop a plan to implement the strategic recommendations; manage the execution
Be a mentor to junior team members
The learning curve is steep and the rewards – global travel, influential connections, world-class global training, personal satisfaction, unparalleled career-development, and, yes, financial – are second to none.
Given the workload and performance expectations of this position, consultants are regularly required to work more than 50 hours/week to perform essential duties of the job.

Flexibility: Paid holidays, vacation, personal sick time, flexibility, and accommodation. Plus, flexible breaks and family leave policies
Learning: A culture of mentorship across all roles, and full lifecycle career support, training, and planning

You'll work in teams of typically 3 - 5 consultants to identify, and oftentimes implement, potential solutions for a specific client problem or challenge.
Together, you will help clients make lasting improvements to their performance and realize their most important goals.
Over the course of each project, you will gather and analyze information, formulate and test hypotheses, and develop and communicate recommendations. You'll also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. In some cases, you will be asked to travel to your client site.
You are joining a firm whose culture is distinctive and inclusive. We will accelerate your development as a leader to create positive, enduring change in the world. You will receive training and coaching on how to better: structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them; synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods; work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act; establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations; communicate effectively with all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner; develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths, and personal values; and develop your functional expertise in digitalisation and technology strategy.
McKinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include a senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals. Additionally, you will have a professional development manager who manages staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams.
You’ll be part of Tech & AI at McKinsey and will be based in based in Casablanca. Tech & AI at McKinsey brings together the best of McKinsey’s digital capabilities to help our clients use digital technology to transform their businesses.
As part of this group, you’ll join a global team working on everything from IT modernization and digital strategy to agile, cloud and digital business building. You’ll typically work on projects across all industries and functions and will be fully integrated with the rest of our global firm.
You’ll also work with colleagues from across McKinsey & Company to help our clients deliver breakthrough products, experiences and businesses, both on technology and non-technology topics.

Who you will work with
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities, Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I),R&I-Hyderabad/Mumbai
 If you are passionate about providing quality insights obtained through research and would like to leverage your strengths to support Deloitte’s thoughtware, this could be the role for you. The role provides an opportunity to get involved in activities that help develop and deliver Deloitte’s thought leadership and client briefings in the power and utilities sector (P&U) and renewable energy (RE) industry. A self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working well in a close-knit team would be a good fit. As part of this team, you’ll gain exposure to a variety of resources and collaboration opportunities that will help in developing your skills and professional development.
 Please explore deloitte.com and deloitte.com/insights to explore our papers and capabilities.
 Work you'll do
 As a Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities on the Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) Research & Insights (R&I) team, you will be responsible for…
 • Developing research proposals and hypotheses for thought leadership and client briefings focused on the power and utilities and renewable energy industries.
 • Conducting secondary research, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, and synthesizing findings into industry perspectives.
 • Applying research methodologies, including surveys, financial analysis, and case studies, to support business decision-making.
 • Preparing research briefings, written materials, and presentation content for clients and Deloitte leaders.
 • Collaborating with project leads and senior team members in the United States and India to deliver research projects.
 The team
 The PU&R sector is part of the broader Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) industry team within the R&I group. The ER&I industry team comprises individuals with varied subject matter expertise and skill sets that enables members to work both independently and collaboratively on small and large projects.
 The overall R&I group’s objective is to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The perspectives are formed by regular scanning and analysis of shaping trends, industry and company level developments, and regulatory environment. The group plays an integral role in strengthening the firm's strategic positioning in the marketplace and through end-to-end development of high-quality thoughtware.
 Location: Mumbai, Hyderabad
 Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM
 Qualifications
 Required:
 • Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM).

 • Experience analyzing quantitative and qualitative data and producing written research reports, client briefings, or presentation materials.
 • Experience applying at least one research methodology: surveys, financial analysis, case studies, forecasting or simulation, text analysis, regulatory review, mergers and acquisitions analysis, or social-media research.
 • Experience using one or more online research databases, including Bloomberg, Hoovers, Factiva, OneSource, Thomson, or AlphaSense.
 • Experience preparing business presentations for clients or senior leaders.

 • Experience using Tableau or Microsoft Power BI to develop data visualizations.
 • Experience using generative artificial intelligence tools for research or productivity workflows and validating source information before including it in research outputs.
 • Experience working with virtual teams in India and the United States.

Job Description: Senior Healthcare Interoperability Specialist
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Healthcare Interoperability Specialist with 4-6 years of experience in the healthcare technology domain, especially in healthcare interoperability, clinical data modelling, data transformation, and integration workflows.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards, along with practical experience in openEHR template/archetype design, healthcare data mapping, terminology mapping, and interface validation.
This role requires someone who can contribute not only as an individual contributor but also support solutioning, technical design, team guidance, and stakeholder discussions. The candidate should be able to work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, validate, and improve scalable healthcare interoperability solutions.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead and contribute to the design, development, and implementation of healthcare interoperability solutions and platforms.
• Work with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards to design and implement healthcare data exchange workflows.
• Design, review, and maintain openEHR templates, archetypes, and clinical data models based on clinical and business requirements.
• Perform healthcare data mapping, transformation, and validation across different standards and source systems.
• Support terminology and concept mapping activities, including mapping of clinical concepts, codes, and value sets.
• Conduct interface testing, API testing, payload validation, and compliance checks against agreed specifications and standards.
• Participate in and drive solutioning, technical design, and architecture discussions for interoperability use cases.
• Help define data flow, transformation logic, integration approach, and validation strategy for healthcare interfaces.
• Collaborate with technical teams, business teams, clinical stakeholders, and external partners to clarify requirements and ensure correct implementation.
• Lead, guide, and mentor team members on interoperability standards, mapping logic, template design, and implementation approach.
• Review deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with healthcare interoperability standards.
• Track and report project progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership.
• Stay updated with evolving healthcare interoperability standards, implementation guides, and industry best practices.
Qualifications
• 3-5 years of experience in the healthcare IT domain, with a strong focus on healthcare interoperability.
• Hands-on experience with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards.
• Strong experience in healthcare data modelling, data transformation, mappings, and integration workflows.
• Practical experience in designing and maintaining openEHR templates and archetypes.
• Experience in mapping healthcare data between different formats, systems, and standards.
• Experience in testing and validating healthcare interfaces, APIs, messages, and payloads.
• Experience in participating in or driving technical solutioning, design discussions, and implementation planning.
• Experience in guiding team members and reviewing technical deliverables.
• Familiarity with databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar relational databases.
• Basic programming or scripting knowledge is preferred; Java knowledge is an added advantage.
• Educational background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.
Skills and Competencies
• Strong understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and clinical data exchange.
• Good understanding of openEHR modelling, template design, archetypes, and clinical data structures.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to understand clinical/business requirements and translate them into technical designs and mappings.
• Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work with cross-functional and distributed teams.
• Ability to guide team members and provide technical direction.
• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, correctness, and compliance.
• Good documentation, reporting, and presentation skills.
• Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and gaps in requirements or implementation.
Preferred Qualifications
• Advanced degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Certification in HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR, openEHR, or healthcare interoperability standards is good to have but not mandatory.
• Experience with integration engines or healthcare integration tools such as Mirth Connect, NiFi, or similar tools is an added advantage.
• Experience with healthcare terminology standards such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD, or concept/value set mapping is an added advantage.
• Experience working on CDR, EHR, EMR, data integration, or healthcare data platform implementations is preferred.

We are looking for a high-performing person with expertise in Commercial Advisory services. As a Consultant, you will be responsible for working on engagements in M&A strategy, market feasibility study, commercial due diligence, strategy development, business plan review, competition assessment, etc.

- Prepare, manage, and deliver assignments: typically have day-to-day responsibility for managing small assignments or major modules of larger assignments. This includes liaison with clients and other stakeholders, understanding client issues, defining problem statement, developing hypotheses, structuring the approach and analysis, developing projections & business plans and directing key individuals within the team.
- Develop an approach and conduct the detailed research and analysis to address areas of scope in the engagement, utilising appropriate tools and techniques
- Get involved in business development and marketing activities to initiate and maintain contact with target companies, private equity and other clients.

- Build own understanding of our purpose and values; explore opportunities for impact.
- Demonstrate strong commitment to personal learning and development; act as a brand ambassador to help attract top talent.

- Actively focus on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills.

- Microsoft Office proficiency.
- Ability and willingness to travel inside and outside of Egypt on a frequent basis with tight deadlines and demanding client requests.
- Strong written and oral communication skills in English and Arabic.
- Strong analytical capability, structured approach to problem solving, with good commercial acumen, business sense and financial knowledge.
- Self-motivated, and willing to solve challenges and work under pressure.

- Ability to meet strict deadlines in high pace and dynamic environment.

Connect to your Industry
Our clients are typically some of the largest and most influential organisations in their industry sector. They operate in an ever-changing environment characterised by uncertainty, where their reputational value is often determined by how they respond to disruption, risk and opportunity. Whether it be cyber threats, political and regulatory change or disruptive innovation, our clients need to navigate shocks, high impact events and change. Our leading Reputation, Crisis and Resilience (RCR) team supports clients in this intellectually challenging context by helping them better plan for and build resilience to strategic risks, issues and incidents, and crises.

Connect to your career at Deloitte 
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more. 
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. You will have the opportunity to work with senior client executives and a wide range of functional teams across a broad range of industries, helping them build resilience to a diverse set of strategic, operational and technology risks. You’ll be based in London or Manchester with hybrid working.

Our commitment to you 
Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.

Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.

A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.

Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un Consultant Senior en Customer & Business Transformation F/H. Vous serez amené à conduire des projets de définition de stratégies marketing, de construction de la relation client de demain ou encore de digitalisation de l'expérience client, en collaboration avec toutes les équipes transverses d’EY (Experience Design, Analytics, IT, Strategy…)
Vos principales responsabilités 
Au sein de nos équipes vous participez à des missions visant à :
• Cadrer des projets d'envergure de transformation CRM, E-commerce et Marketplace :

• Développer une stratégie marketing pour nos clients :

- En tant que senior, je conduis des activités et fournis des livrables clients en autonomie

- En tant que senior, je réalise des propositions commerciales pour des prospects et suis à l’écoute d’opportunités chez mes clients

• Expérience significative d’au moins 2 ans en Conseil avec une expertise digitale forte, à la fois stratégique, technologique et centrée client.
• Niveau d’anglais courant (oral et écrit)
• Une expérience sur les sujets CRM ou data est un plus.
Ce que nous recherchons : 
• Formation supérieure de haut niveau (grande école d’ingénieurs ou grande école de commerce)
• Une personne dynamique et dotée d'un excellent sens relationnel
• Une capacité d’adaptation à des environnements variés face à des interlocuteurs de comité de direction
• Un très bon sens du service client
• Avoir de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse
Ce que nous vous offrons : 
• Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
• Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY
• L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U.
• Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo.
• De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris..
Etes-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.
Processus de recrutement : 
Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 entretiens (RH et métier). Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions. Lors des entretiens métiers, nous vous proposerons également un exercice d’étude de cas ou market sizing à réaliser in situ.
Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.
EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.

Desde Business Consulting Transformation para la industria de servicios financieros buscamos ayudar a nuestros clientes de Banking, FinTech, Payment & Insurance a adoptar la transformación de sus negocios en una era tan dinámica y disruptiva como la actual. keywords: strategy, SQL, Python, transformation
jd_text:
Wien | Vollzeit | ab sofort | Consulting
Dein Team & Umfeld
Unser rund 35-köpfiges Technology Strategy & Transformation Team unterstützt Unternehmen bei der digitalen Transformation ihrer Geschäfts- und Technologielandschaften. Wir begleiten Kund:innen bei der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte, Prozessoptimierungen und modernen Technologielösungen – von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Ein wesentlicher Erfolgsfaktor ist dabei unsere Schnittstellenfunktion, in der wir Business und IT zusammenführen und lösungsorientiert beraten.
Unser modernes Office im IZD-Tower mit Blick auf die Donau bietet Raum für Produktivität, kreative Pausen in der EY-Lounge und echten Teamspirit.
Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten
• Entwicklung und Implementierung innovativer digitaler Lösungen gemeinsam mit Business Analyst:innen und Solution Architekt:innen
• Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen sowie Übersetzung in Anforderungen, User Stories und umsetzbare Konzepte
• Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung moderner Anwendungen und Plattformlösungen
• Erstellung von Präsentationen, Konzepten und Lösungsdesigns für Kund:innen und Projektteams
• Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und agilen Projektteams
• Erste Verantwortung für Konzeptions- und Umsetzungsprojekte sowie definierte Arbeitspakete; für erfahrene Consultants auch (Teil)Projektleitung
• Unterstützung unserer Kund:innen bei der digitalen Transformation und Optimierung ihrer Prozesse
Fähigkeiten für deinen Erfolg
Must-haves:
• Abgeschlossenes technisches bzw. wirtschaftlich-technisches Studium (z. B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar)
• Erste bis mehrjährige Projekterfahrung im Anforderungsmanagement, Requirements Engineering oder in der Prozessanalyse; für erfahrene Consultants zusätzlich Erfahrung mit Datenmapping und der Formulierung von Geschäftsregeln
• Grundlegende bis fundierte Kenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung oder Programmierung (z. B. JavaScript, Python oder SQL)
• Sicherer Umgang mit KI-gestützten Tools beziehungsweise Interesse daran, neue Technologien im Arbeitsalltag aktiv einzusetzen
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-Niveau)
Nice-to-haves:
• Kenntnisse in User Journey Mapping, Use-Case-Modellierung oder Ideation-Methoden
• Erfahrung im Solution Design, REST APIs oder modernen Plattformarchitekturen
• Für erfahrene Consultants: Beratungs- und Projektleitungserfahrung im Bereich Digitalisierung, Technology Transformation oder Softwareentwicklung
• Industrieerfahrung, bevorzugt in den Branchen Banken & Versicherungen, produzierendes Gewerbe oder Logistik
Das bieten wir dir
• Flexibilität im Alltag: Homeoffice, Workation, Sabbatical sowie flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle ermöglichen eine individuelle Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags.
• Mobilität: Übernahme der Kosten für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sowie zusätzliche Angebote wie Bike-Leasing erleichtern deinen Weg ins Office.
• Gelebte Feedbackkultur: Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, klare Entwicklungsziele und transparente Leistungsbeurteilung begleiten deinen Karriereweg bei EY.
• Weiterentwicklung: Vielfältige Trainings, Coachings und Zertifizierungen, z. B. im Bereich ServiceNow, Scrum oder Projektmanagement.
• Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Projekte mit Teams und Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichen Ländern.
• Teamkultur: Regelmäßiger Austausch, Teamevents und gemeinsame Weiterentwicklung stehen bei uns im Mittelpunkt.
• Wellbeing: Angebote wie kostenfreie psychologische Beratung, Coaching-Möglichkeiten sowie Initiativen zur mentalen Unterstützung stärken dein persönliches Wohlbefinden.
• Sport & Ausgleich: Vergünstigtes myClubs Abo mit Zugang zu vielfältigen Sport- und Freizeitangeboten fördern den Ausgleich im Alltag.
• „Bring a Friend“: Das eigene Netzwerk lohnt sich – Empfehlungen werden mit einer Prämie honoriert.
Das jährliche Bruttogehalt für diese Position beträgt bei Einstieg auf Rank Consultant € 49.000 (All-in-Vertrag). Das tatsächliche Gehalt richtet sich nach deiner Berufserfahrung, Qualifikation und Einstufung und wird durch leistungsorientierte Boni ergänzt. Mit deiner Karriere bei EY entwickelt sich auch deine Vergütung weiter. Dabei gilt stets: „Equal Pay for Equal Work“.
Dein Bewerbungsprozess
• Erstes telefonisches Gespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (ca. 5-10 Minuten)
• Fachliches Gespräch mit dem jeweiligen Team
• Je nach Position kann ein weiteres Gespräch oder eine Case Study folgen
Nach jedem Schritt erfolgt zeitnah Feedback. Abhängig von der Position kann der Prozess variieren.
Deine Ansprechperson: Klara Schlichtinger klara.schlichtinger@at.ey.com (Recruiting)
Du hast Lust, kreativ zu werden? Dann sende gerne eine Videobewerbung per Mail an deine:n Recruiter:in. Für klassische Bewerbungen nutze bitte ausschließlich unser Online-Tool.
Über EY
EY zählt zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen in der Prüfung und Beratung. In Österreich sind wir an fünf Standorten vertreten und bieten ein breites Spektrum an Leistungen in den Bereichen Wirtschaftsprüfung sowie Steuer-, Rechts- und Unternehmensberatung. Vielfalt ist ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Kultur. Mit Initiativen wie Inclusiveness@EY fördern wir Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Religion. Weltweit sind wir Teil eines Netzwerks von über 400.000 Expert:innen in mehr als 150 Ländern – vereint durch unseren gemeinsamen Anspruch: „Shape the future with confidence“. Gestalte die digitale Zukunft führender Unternehmen! Im Team Technology Strategy & Transformation entwickelst du innovative IT-Strategien und begleitest komplexe Transformationsprojekte. • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar

El área de Financial Services (FSO) es un importante diferenciador de EY. Somos la única firma de servicios profesionales que cuenta con una unidad de negocios independiente que reúne todos nuestros servicios, ya sea de auditoría, consultoría, impuestos o estrategia y transacciones, dedicada exclusivamente a los clientes de los segmentos de Mercado de Capitales, Bancos, Seguros y Gestión de Activos, para asegurar que brindamos un servicio excepcional a corto y largo plazo en un entorno regulatorio en constante cambio.
La oportunidad: tu próxima aventura te espera
En el equipo de Business Consulting para empresas de la industria financiera, el Senior del proyecto tendrá la responsabilidad de contribuir significativamente al delivery de proyectos de consultoría, apoyando al líder del equipo de proyecto y colaborando activamente en el cumplimiento de los objetivos con el enfoque de EY apropiado para el proyecto. Participará activamente en la motivación del equipo para el logro de resultados en tiempo y calidad, alineados con las necesidades y el desarrollo del cliente. Los proyectos en los que colaborará abarcan desde la definición de la estrategia corporativa hasta la implementación de los modelos de negocios y el seguimiento de la implementación (PMO). Como Senior, aportarás en el diseño de marcos y soluciones para satisfacer las necesidades de los clientes. Nuestros servicios se centran en “cerrar la brecha entre la Ejecución y la Estrategia", principalmente a través del diseño y la implementación de marcos y soluciones que permitan a las compañías tomar decisiones basadas en datos para optimizar y administrar su estrategia y mejorar sus procesos de negocio.
Tus responsabilidades clave
- Realizar el delivery de proyectos de Business Consulting para asesorar a nuestros clientes en temáticas de estrategia en transformación de negocios en distintas áreas para la Industria Financiera.
- Liderar proyectos de consultoría en clientes de la industria financiera principalmente Bancos, Corredoras y Administradoras de Fondos, relacionados a la mejora y optimización de procesos, análisis y evaluaciones de herramientas, implementaciones, project management, diseño de planes estratégicos, entre otros.
- Trabajar de cerca con nuestros equipos de soluciones en tecnología para buscar maneras de utilizar la tecnología creativamente para apoyar los procesos como parte del diseño general de la solución.
- Gestionar el plan y el alcance del proyecto
- Liderar presentaciones ejecutivas a Clientes C-Level
- Desarrollar propuestas comerciales.
- Promover la innovación de soluciones.
- Asesorar clientes en sus respectivas consultas y necesidades.
Lo que buscamos
· Tener una mentalidad ágil y orientada al crecimiento. Lo que sabes importa. Pero la mentalidad correcta es igualmente importante para determinar el éxito. Buscamos personas innovadoras, que puedan trabajar de manera ágil y seguir el ritmo de un mundo que cambia rápidamente.
· Ser curioso/a y tener un propósito. Buscamos personas que vean oportunidades en lugar de desafíos, que hagan mejores preguntas para buscar mejores respuestas que creen un mejor mundo laboral.
· Ser inclusivo/a. Buscamos personas que busquen y adopten perspectivas diversas, que valoren las diferencias y trabajen en equipo de manera inclusiva para generar seguridad y confianza.

Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres auf den Finanzdienstleistungssektor spezialisierten Data & AI Teams in München, Frankfurt/Main, Düsseldorf, Köln, Stuttgart, Hamburg oder Berlin berätst du unsere Kund:innen zu Themen rund um die Konzeption und den Aufbau modernster Datenplattformen, sowie bei der Umsetzung von innovativen Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning und AI-Anwendungen und bei der Operationalisierung dieser Anwendungen. • Beratung unserer Kund:innen bei der Entwicklung von Lösungen für herausfordernde Problemstellungen mit Hilfe von Advanced Analytics und AI, von der Konzeption über die Strategie bis hin zur Umsetzung
• Konzeption und Aufbau modernster Datenplattformen und eines entsprechenden Datenmanagements, sowie die Umsetzung geschäftsrelevanter Anwendungen 
• Aktive Einbindung in die Durchführung und die Planung sämtlicher Phasen innerhalb großer IT-Transformationsprojekte

• Eigenverantwortliche Übernahme von Teilaufgaben in der Weiterentwicklung unseres Service Portfolios als Teil unserer Data & AI Community

• Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, (Wirtschafts-) Mathematik, Physik, Statistik, des Ingenieurwesens oder einer anderen Studienrichtung mit technologisch-analytischem Hintergrund

Chez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur.
Notre Opportunité : 
Pour faire face aux besoins de nos clients et à notre ambition de croissance au sein de notre équipe Technology Strategy & Transformation, nous recherchons des Consultant(e)s séniors en Transformation Management Office.
Vos principales responsabilités : 
• Aider les clients à concevoir et à mettre en œuvre des programmes de transformation d'entreprise
• Structurer et cadrer un portefeuille de projets permettant de dérouler un programme de transformation
• Participer activement à la gestion de programmes de transformation (coordination des tâches, suivi jalons projet, pilotage budgétaire, reporting et gestion des ressources)

• Sécuriser / accompagner l’implémentation des projets, la réalisation, la livraison et le run ​
Vos Compétences pour réussir : 
• Savoir collaborer avec les clients pour aligner les plans de transformation sur la stratégie IT globale de l'entreprise
• Comprendre les enjeux métiers nécessaires à la réalisation d’un schéma directeur pertinent
• Maitriser les outils et méthodologie de gestion de projets afin de piloter un projet/ programme par la valeur (KPI de performance, OKR…)
• Certifications: PMP/ SAFE LPM, PSPM
• La maitrise des outils PPM est un plus (Planisware, ServiceNow SPM, Clarity, Orchestra etc.)
Ce que nous recherchons : 
• Expérience approfondie d’au minimum 3 ans après la sortie de formation supérieur, dans la gestion de programmes ou de projets de transformation en cabinet de Conseil.
• Expériences solides sur l’un de nos secteurs d’activité : Secteur Public, Grande Distribution, Produits de grande consommation, Télécommunications, Energie, Industrie…
• Capacité à échanger avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau (type C-Level) et sens poussé de la relation client.
• Anglais oral et écrit courant
Ce que nous vous offrons : 
• Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
• Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY
• L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U.
• Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo.
• De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris..
Etes-vous prêt(e) à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.
Processus de recrutement : 
Le processus de recrutement est composé en moyenne de 3 entretiens (RH et métier). Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions.
Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.
EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.

Your key responsibilities
EY’s Transformation Architecture and Delivery (TAD) practice offers a dynamic career path for professionals passionate about solving complex business, technology, and infrastructure challenges. Your work will focus on designing technology operating models, optimizing costs and sourcing strategies, supporting M&A transaction and integration initiatives, and enabling enterprise-wide technology transformation. You'll shape governance frameworks, develop transformation roadmaps, and help organizations modernize their technology capabilities to improve performance, agility, and business outcomes. Through strategy, implementation, and value realization, you'll help clients build future-ready technology organizations.

jd_text:
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Gestalte die digitale Zukunft führender Unternehmen mit. Im Team Technology Strategy & Transformation entwickelst du innovative IT-Strategien und begleitest komplexe Transformationsprojekte. Wir verbinden Technologie, Business und Menschen, um nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen – von Cloud-Architekturen und FinOps bis zu agilen Operating Models. Dabei behalten wir Trends wie Künstliche Intelligenz, AI Financial Management, AI FinOps und Automatisierung im Blick. In unserem Team wirst du vielfältige Aufgaben übernehmen, darunter:
• Du berätst Unternehmen bei der Steuerung, Optimierung und Transparenz ihrer IT-Kosten und entwickelst zukunftsfähige Financial-Management-Ansätze für die IT.
• Du unterstützt CIOs und IT-Organisationen dabei, den Wertbeitrag von IT, Digitalisierung, Cloud und AI messbar zu machen und fundierte Managemententscheidungen zu ermöglichen.
• Du entwickelst KPI-, Reporting- und Steuerungsmodelle für moderne IT-Organisationen und schaffst Transparenz über Kosten, Leistungen und Ergebnisse.
• Du arbeitest an strategischen Themen wie IT-Budgetplanung, Kostenkontrolle, IT Value Management sowie der finanziellen Steuerung von Transformationsprogrammen.
• Du analysierst Cloud- und AI-Kostenstrukturen, identifizierst Kostentreiber und entwickelst konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen im Umfeld von FinOps, AI Financial Management und Cost Optimization.
Dein Skillset
• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs und bringst erste Erfahrungen im IT Financial Management, Controlling oder IT-Performance-Umfeld mit.
• Du verfügst über die für die Position erforderlichen fachlichen Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Cloud- und FinOps-Umfeld und interessierst dich für Zukunftsthemen wie AI Financial Management, AI FinOps und datengetriebene Kostenoptimierung.
• Du überzeugst durch analytisches Denken, den sicheren Umgang mit Kosten-, Verbrauchs- und Performance-Daten sowie durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1-Niveau).
Dein Mindset
• Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
• Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
• Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

Vi søker erfarne konsulenter til vårt Technology, Strategy & Transformation miljø på våre kontorer i Oslo, Trondheim og Stavanger.

Kort sagt med å løse komplekse utfordringer i skjæringspunktet mellom strategi og teknologi. Vi hjelper kundene våre med å etablere retning, ta gode beslutninger og sikre at initiativer gir ønskede resultater og varig verdi.
Vi bistår hovedsakelig kunder innen offentlig sektor, infrastruktur, helse, energi, finans og retail. Du blir en del av et tverrfaglig rådgivningsmiljø som hjelper virksomheter med å lykkes i grensesnittet mellom teknologi og virksomhet. Vi hjelper kundene med å oppnå verdi fra digitale transformasjoner.

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 
Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Our Climate Change and Sustainability Service (CCaSS) team seeks to build a better working world by helping businesses and governments respond to societal, environmental and economic challenges. We help businesses understand and evaluate the broader value impacts and outcomes associated with their organizations, operations, programs and projects. Our global team is multidisciplinary and combines our core knowledge in accounting and reporting with knowledge in technical and regulatory sustainability issues.
We provide ESG related advisory services to financial market participants, large corporate clients and state owned enterprises too.
Our teams help clients identify their ESG Strategies and action plans, execute impacts with purpose, and continuously improve and report on their sustainability performance. Specifically, we help clients manage emerging risks such as climate risk, reduce costs through design and implementation of systems and processes, and leverage opportunities in areas such as sustainable finance, climate change, circular economy or the European sustainability policies both within their organization and within their supply chains and customer base.
Your key responsibilities
• Collaborate with the other Senior Consultants and Managers to execute EY’s ESG strategy that satisfies high client expectations, support the planning, execution and delivery of the engagements
• Possess the ability to communicate clearly at all levels of the organization about complex issues; and also be able to review the work and act as a mentor of junior colleagues
• Contribute actively in the CCaSS engagement team to understand and respond to the client's needs and expectations and develop a client-focused, clear, accurate and well-presented offerings, proposals and work product
• Ensure work is delivered in a timely manner and in compliance with EY’s high standard requirements
• Work with other service lines and subject matter experts in providing an integrated service delivery across functions in an international team to meet the client expectations of a professionally managed EY network.
• Help to identify and communicate relevant industry trends, regulatory and market developments and key performance drivers towards clients.
• Assist in identifying and developing new opportunities related to new CCaSS projects and business relationships.
Skills and attributes for success
Proactive, accountable and results driven people will flourish in this environment. Dealing with competing priorities, understanding how to manage your own resources and communicating effectively are key skills. This will have a huge impact on those around you and help promote a positive work ethic.
To qualify for the role, you must have
• Undergraduate degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline: e.g. Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Environmental sciences, Legal, Regulatory or other relevant field
• Min. 2-3 years of relevant experience in ESG, sustainability, environment or climate change in any profession, but preferably with a consulting mindset
• We’re looking for people who are innovative, agile, have a growth-oriented mindset and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
• You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers that build a better working world.
• You are inclusive. We’re looking for people who seek and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.
• You have interest in ESG, climate change and sustainability related areas or topics. 
• You have strong technical, quantitative and analytical skills.
• You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hungarian.
What we offer
• Competitive compensation package: performance-based bonus eligibility, cafeteria, regular training opportunities, private life insurance, health insurance – including various laboratory tests and outpatient services.
• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
• Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
• Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build. Apply now!

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Zeker van je impact vandaag | Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen
Dienstverlenende organisaties, zoals publieke uitvoeringsorganisaties, banken en global consumer organisaties, staan voor de uitdaging om hun operationele processen te optimaliseren en tegelijkertijd de kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid te waarborgen. Als Senior Consultant Operations help je deze organisaties om hun strategieën en processen te verbeteren, zodat ze effectiever en efficiënter kunnen opereren.
Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Als Senior Consultant Operations ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties.
• Je geeft advies over de inrichting van operationele processen en zorgt ervoor dat de impact op de organisatie duurzaam is.
• Door data-analyse en tooling in te zetten, meet en verbeter je de operationele prestaties.
• Je fungeert als de schakel tussen verschillende afdelingen zoals planning, productie, control & finance en bent in staat om teams te inspireren en begeleiden in veranderingsprocessen.
Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor
Binnen de afdeling Operations zetten wij onze expertise in om organisaties te ondersteunen bij complexe verbetervraagstukken. Wij geloven dat onze diepgaande kennis van verschillende sectoren en procesverbeteringsmethodologieën, zoals Lean, Six Sigma of Agile, het verschil kan maken. Wij helpen onze klanten niet alleen door middel van aanbevelingen, maar zijn ook actief betrokken bij de uitvoering van verbeterinitiatieven. Door samen te werken met onze klanten helpen we hen om hun operationele doelstellingen te behalen.
Jouw kantoor
Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze High-Tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen.
Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage
• Je hebt een WO Master in (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, Operations Management, Business Economics, Business Information Management of een vergelijkbare studie afgerond.
• 2 - 5 jaar werkervaring in operations management of een vergelijkbare rol, bij voorkeur in een senior positie.
• Je hebt ervaring met procesverbeteringsmethodologieën zoals Lean, Six Sigma of Agile.
• Je bent analytisch sterk, beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk).
• Je bent resultaatgericht met een sterke focus het behalen van projectdoelstellingen en klanttevredenheid.
Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier
• Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Bovenop je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).
• Je krijgt een contract voor 32-40 uur per week
• Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.
• 29 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken + de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen.
• Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.
• Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt.
• De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken.
• De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen.
• Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.
• Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing.
• Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.
• Dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier
Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces
• Snel en eenvoudig solliciteren – Stuur ons alleen je cv. Zo maken we het jou makkelijk om snel te solliciteren.
• Kennismakingsgesprek – Binnen een week neemt onze recruiter contact met je op om te kijken of de rol bij je past.
• Online assessment – Voor het interview maak je een korte, game-based assessment die jouw cognitieve vaardigheden en gedragsvoorkeuren in kaart brengt. De resultaten bespreken we samen tijdens het interview.
• Interviews – Je eerste gesprek is met onze recruiter en een collega uit de betreffende afdeling. Dit is een wederzijdse kennismaking: wij leren jou kennen en jij ons. Als er een match is, gaan we tijdens het tweede gesprek dieper in op de rol en andere relevante onderwerpen. Soms hoort hier ook een business case bij. Vaak volgt er nog een laatste gesprek om alle openstaande vragen te bespreken.
• Aanbod & pre-employment screening – Als we beiden enthousiast zijn, ontvang je een aanbod en ronden we de pre-employment screening af. Daarna kan jouw avontuur bij EY beginnen.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

The opportunity
At EY-Parthenon we support you in achieving your unique potential both personally and professionally. You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We’re looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.

You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers that build a better working world.

Excellent analytical and presentation skills

Accelerate your technical capabilities and transformative leadership skills with future-focused courses and development programs.

Broaden your horizons by working on highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds — both professionally and culturally.

Bring out the best in yourself with continuous investment in your personal well-being and career development.

Develop your own personal purpose and help us create a positive ripple effect on our teams, our business, clients and society – building a better working world, together.

Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 
Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Confidence in your impact today| Freedom to build tomorrow 
At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field. 
Your new job | About your main responsibilities 
As a Senior Consultant in Procurement you help leading companies with for example their Procurement operating model, strategy development, strategy implementation, sustainable sourcing or a spend analysis. As a consultant your role will be to lead a sub project within client engagements. You will work independently as well as in teams at our clients, supporting them with improving their business performance. You will use your quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to help structure and analyse the problems of the client and report the findings and results. Drawing on your knowledge, skills, and experience, you will start to build valued relationships with external clients and internal peers. You will play an active role and contribute to the EY SC&O team internally by developing project proposals, solutions, trainings, and thought leadership.  
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office 
Our clients place considerable trust in us and our advice, and people who are passionate about going above and beyond to improve our working world, unifies us as a team. This is crucial in enabling us to consistently deliver or exceed on our commitments. Build, maintain and strengthen relationships to increasingly become a trusted point of contact within Procurement. Your team is delivering Procurement projects for industry-leading clients in and outside the Netherlands, within a multi-disciplinary team. The team delivers solutions for complex and existing challenges in the field of Procurement (e.g. Sustainability regulations and compliance, or spend analysis and cost optimization). 
Your office 
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe. 
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution 
• 2-5 years’ work experience in a Procurement related environment (Consulting or business).  
• A master’s degree preferably in the field of Business, Operations management, or Supply Chain Management. 
• An analytical and a structured way of working, you are strong in conceptual thinking, and you have a great drive and are enthusiastic.  
• Proactive and energetic, with innovative qualities that enable high quality work to be delivered often in relatively short timeframes. 
• Collaborative team player, with the capability to work within cross-functional teams, collaborating with colleagues from different countries and departments to achieve common goals.
• Results oriented, focused on achieving high quality value to clients, and continuously striving for excellence. 
• Proficiency in project management, to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, ensuring deadlines are met, and clients are kept informed.
• Fluent language skills in English & Dutch. 
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment 
• A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development). 
• You’ll receive a 32- 40 hours contract. 
• A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
• 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.
• With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
• At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
• The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
• The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
• You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
• Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
• A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
• All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here. 
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process 
1. For this vacancy, we only ask for your CV. This way, it’s quick and easy to apply. 
2. First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have. 
3. Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow. 
4. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY! 
EY  |  Building a better working world  
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
