jd_text:
Company Description
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Job Description
As a Transformation Management (Senior) Consultant at Sia Netherlands, you will be a trusted advisor to (senior) client stakeholders designing and delivering end-to-end change programmes that turn strategic ambition into measurable organisational impact. You will operate at the intersection of strategy, people, and technology, guiding organisations through digital transformations, operating model redesigns, mergers & acquisitions, and regulatory-driven change.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Consulting Delivery
- Lead and manage complex transformation and change management projects from scoping through execution and benefits realisation.
- Develop change strategies, roadmaps, and governance frameworks tailored to client context and culture.
- Design and facilitate stakeholder engagement, impact assessments, and readiness evaluations.
- Build and coach client-side change agent networks to embed sustainable capability.
- Manage project workstreams, timelines, budgets, and quality deliverables to agreed standards.
Client & Business Development
- Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with clients.
- Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and support proposal development for new business.
- Represent Sia at industry events, thought-leadership forums, and client workshops.
Internal Contribution
- Mentor and develop junior consultants, providing day-to-day guidance and structured feedback.
- Contribute to internal knowledge assets, methodologies, and practice-area toolkits.
- Actively participate in recruiting, onboarding, and capability-building initiatives.

Qualifications
Experience & Education
- 1–5 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in a management-consulting or in-house transformation role.
- Demonstrated track record delivering change management programmes in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
- Experience working in financial services (insurance, banking, pension, payments, asset management)
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Econometrics, Organisational Psychology, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- Certification in change management (e.g. Prosci / ADKAR, APMG Change Management) is a strong asset.
Technical & Methodological Skills
- Knowledge of change management frameworks (Kotter, ADKAR, McKinsey 7-S, Lewin, etc.).
- Proficiency in project and programme management methodologies (PRINCE2, PMI, SAFe / Agile).
- Ability to design and execute organisational design, communications, training, and adoption strategies.
- Comfortable working on digital transformation programmes (ERP, CRM, cloud, AI adoption).
- Strong data literacy able to use data to build the case for change and track adoption KPIs.
Interpersonal & Leadership Qualities
- Excellent communication and presentation skills able to simplify complexity for executive audiences.
- High emotional intelligence and ability to build trust quickly at all organisational levels.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to grow the practice and develop new client relationships.
- You like to work in a team but you are capable to excel on your own as well and are not afraid to share your thoughts.
- You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
- Fluency in English and Dutch language skills is requiered.
- Eligible to work in the Netherlands (EU citizens or valid work authorisation).
What do we offer?
- Competitive salary with great extra advantages: a clear and structured yearly salary increase and bonuses.
- Flexible transport options that match your personal needs.
- Training plan to develop yourself as an expert in your discipline.
- You have the opportunity to work from home, the client or our inspiring office in Amsterdam or Maastricht.
- Working in an international environment creates opportunities to share knowledge and work together on international projects with colleagues all over the world.

Additional Information
We are unable to provide a work permit for this position.
Non-Dutch speaker will not be accepted.
Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

jd_text:
Company Description
We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. 
As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. 
Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. 
We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. 
Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands. 
PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life.

Job Description
Do you feel the desire to join a highly motivated team that aims to create positive and lasting changes in the world? 
Our Major Programme Services (MPS) team is looking for an exceptional Commercial & Procurement Specialist. 
As part of PA’s Delivery stream, PA’s Centre of Excellence for all project, programme, and portfolio capability, MPS works across Defence, major projects & infrastructure, transport, and public sector in client-facing roles on long-term assignments. Having experienced repeated successes in delivering value and excellence for our clients, most of whom are within daily commuting range from home, we are in high demand and are now expanding further across the UK. 
As a Procurement & Commercial Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in executing complex projects across various industries. Your expertise and strategic thinking will be crucial in delivering successful outcomes for our clients. 
This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovative environment, shaping projects that drive meaningful impact. 
Location 
Hybrid working - our approach is to be on client site 2 days per week.
You will have opportunity to: 
We typically work with the buyer organisation, sometimes with prime suppliers, on high spend categories, typically in complex equipment and capabilities, digital services, infrastructure and professional services. Some examples of assignments can include the following: 
- Designing and running major procurements: helping clients to understand their requirement and how to leverage major procurements to improve their business; creating the procurement and contracting strategy, creating commercial agreements and advising on how drive the best from the market. 
- Project managing and providing expert advice on the process of procurement: managing supplier engagement; the evaluation of tenders; helping to negotiate and close deals; and making the business case to launch procurements and award agreements. 
- Advising and putting the systems and processes in place to successfully transition from legacy to new frameworks and contracts, and to properly manage major contracts including the associated business change. 
- Reviewing client procurement and commercial team performance and identifying and leading programmes to restructure the function and improve capability. This may include category management, supplier relationship management and sustainable supply chains. 
- Support to renegotiate and improve agreements or help resolve major disputes. 
- Providing effective commercial management for PA’s largest complex assignments, often with large collaborative teams.

Qualifications
About You
This is an opportunity to develop your skills and gain experiences that will take you into the top levels of the profession. Experience will include: 
- Working with large and complex procurements, in any or all of equipment, digital services and infrastructure. 
- Understanding of the procurement lifecycle and comfort around: identifying procurement and commercial strategies; running the processes of sourcing; managing the evaluation of tenders; helping to negotiate and close deals; and properly managing major contracts. 
- Experience advising on contract terms and designing agreements to drive the best from a particular market. 
- Strong interpersonal skills, including recognising how to manage multiple stakeholders. 
- Experience with major government procurements, including the approvals processes, is highly desired. 
- Familiarity using NEC contract forms would be an advantage. 
- Ideally possessing MCIPS or MRICS Chartered status. 
- Project management or financial management skills; this would be an advantage but can be learned. 
We know the skill-gap and ‘somewhat need to tick every box’ can get in the way of meeting brilliant candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply – we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today by completing our online application.

Additional Information
Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work. 
Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self. 
Find out more about Life at PA here. 
We are dedicated to supporting the physical, emotional, social and financial well-being of our people. Check out some of our extensive benefits: 
- Health and lifestyle perks accompanying private healthcare
- 25 days annual leave (plus a bonus half day on Christmas Eve) with the opportunity to buy 5 additional days 
- Generous company pension scheme 
- Opportunity to get involved with community and charity-based initiatives 
- Annual performance-based bonus 
- PA share ownership 
- Tax efficient benefits (cycle to work, give as you earn) 
We’re committed to advancing equality. We recruit, retain, reward and develop our people based solely on their abilities and contributions and without reference to their age, background, disability, genetic information, parental or family status, religion or belief, race, ethnicity, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity (or expression), political belief, veteran status, or any other range of human difference brought about by identity and experience. We welcome applications from underrepresented groups. 
Adjustments or accommodations - Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us on recruitmentenquiries@paconsulting.com

jd_text:
Who We Are?
Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 60 cities across 29 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. The firm has more than 6,000 professionals around the world who work with clients to optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman is a wholly owned subsidiary of Marsh & McLennan Companies [NYSE: MMC]. For more information, visit www.oliverwyman.com.
Job Specification
Practice Group: Financial Services
Practice: Insurance
Location: New York
Role: Associate, Engagement Manager

You aspire to become a leader in global development by tackling global issues, from malnutrition to climate change to economic growth, ensuring no population is left behind. You drive the delivery of innovative and results-oriented solutions for clients, proposing problem-solving and creating tailored frameworks that address client challenges. You excel in solving problems using clear strategic and creative thinking, and you want to put your skills to work – transforming organizations that fund change around the world. You are a committed self-starter with experience as a ‘top-performer’ at a leading international management consultancy firm, a passion for international development, and an entrepreneurial spirit. 
Dalberg consultants live and work around the world, creating a network of local experience anchored by our offices in Africa, Latin America, North America, Europe and Asia. Dalberg combines ground-level insight with experience from top-tier professional services firms and leading academic institutions to create actionable solutions to the world’s most pressing issues.

- Minimum of bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, International Relations or a related field

- Demonstrated fluency with English speaking and writing skills; proficiency with other languages a plus 
Note: Employment in all the Dalberg offices is conditional on the candidate having or obtaining the requisite authorization to live and work in that country. 
WHAT WILL YOU DO AND HOW WILL YOU GROW
Consultants play a significant role in driving the delivery of innovative and results-oriented solutions for our clients. They lead research and analysis for the case, framing the team’s knowledge base around the topic at hand. This includes both, quantitative rigor and gaining primary insights through interviews with stakeholders. As those who dive deep into the issues, they think critically and creatively to develop insights based on their findings from the research process. Not only do Consultants work closely with their managers, but they are also tasked with gaining trust and credibility by working directly with clients and change makers.

Our work also includes evaluating labour rights in agri-food supply chains, supporting livelihood strategies in the private sector, and guiding business planning in the energy access space. We've facilitated disability inclusion roundtables and led the transition of public engagement programs.
Past projects have taken us to a mine in the Indonesian jungle, to refugee camps in remote parts of Kenya, and to the Nepal border to study trafficking transport chains.
Dalberg is a platform for change. Our staff is empowered to start new programs, institute best practices, and develop traditions that will define the Dalberg experience for years to come. Innovation and entrepreneurship are not only valued at Dalberg; they are essential to our firm’s success. jd_text:
Description de l'entreprise
Sia est un groupe international de conseil en management de nouvelle génération, fondé en 1999. Nés à l'ère du digital, nous sommes augmentés par la data, enrichis par la créativité et guidés par la responsabilité. Nous collaborons avec nos clients pour relever les défis et saisir les opportunités. Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nous croyons que l’optimisme est un puissant levier de transformation. Avec une expertise couvrant un large éventail de secteurs et de services, nos 3 000 consultants accompagnent des clients dans le monde entier, depuis 48 bureaux répartis dans 19 pays. Notre expertise produit des résultats concrets. Notre optimisme change la donne.

Description du poste
Vous souhaitez accompagner les organisations dans la transformation de leurs dispositifs de formation, la montée en compétences de leurs collaborateurs et la professionnalisation de leurs pratiques Learning & Development ? 
Rejoignez la Business Unit Human Resources & Transformation, spécialisée dans l’évolution des organisations RH et l’accompagnement des transformations compétences. 
En tant que Consultant.e Senior Learning & Development, vous interviendrez directement auprès de nos clients (CAC 40, SBF 120, ETI / PME) sur les thématiques suivantes : 
Stratégie Learning & Transformation des dispositifs de formation 
- Cadrer, concevoir et déployer des stratégies Learning en cohérence avec les priorités business et les enjeux de développement des compétences. 
- Définir et structurer des plans de développement des compétences robustes : cartographie, priorisation, trajectoires d’évolution. 
- Déployer des universités d’entreprise, académies, programmes métier et parcours managériaux. 
Ingénierie de formation & Learning Journeys 
- Concevoir des parcours blended : présentiel, distanciel, e‑learning, ateliers expérientiels, communautés apprenantes. 
- Piloter la production pédagogique : ingénierie, création ou adaptation de contenus, animation de comités pédagogiques. 
- Développer des dispositifs innovants : micro‑learning, adaptive learning, outils digitaux. 
- Animer des sessions de formation, des ateliers de co-développement. 
Digital Learning 
- Accompagner le déploiement ou la migration de plateformes LMS/LXP (Cornerstone, 360Learning, CrossKnowledge…). 
- Structurer l’écosystème digital Learning 
- Professionnaliser les équipes formation et les administrateurs locaux. 
Pilotage budgétaire 
- Établir et suivre les budgets formation (construction, arbitrage, suivi, optimisation). 
- Piloter les relations avec les OPCO, Transition Pro et autres financeurs : dossiers, montage, suivi et reporting. 
- Produire les bilans formation, rapports sociaux et analyses pour les instances représentatives. 
Change Management 
- Accompagner les managers et les équipes RH dans l’appropriation des dispositifs Learning. 
- Animer des ateliers, communautés de formateurs, actions de montée en compétences internes. 
- Contribuer au développement d’une culture apprenante : communication, posture, engagement. 
Exemples de missions réalisées par nos équipes : 
- Audit, benchmark et performance des académies de formation : CACIB, Renault, Abeille, Naval Group 
- Pilotage, organisation, conception et animation de sessions de formation et de co-développement : Total, Musée du Louvre 
- Pilotage, conception de formation, et accompagnement des utilisateurs : Vinci, Enedis, RATP, SNCF Réseau 
Vous êtes également amené(e) à vous impliquer dans la vie interne du cabinet : développement commercial, rayonnement médiatique de nos offres, etc.

Diplômé(e) d’une grande école d’ingénieur, d’une grande école de management ou d’une grande université avec spécialisation en Ressources Humaines, vous justifiez idéalement d’une expérience réussie d’au moins 4 ans dans le conseil ou auprès de direction des Ressources Humaines. 
Vous disposez d'une appétence pour les enjeux liés à la data et l'IA, d'une capacité à monter en compétences rapidement sur ces sujets et êtes enthousiaste à l'idée d'accompagner nos clients à en saisir les opportunités.

Description de l'entreprise
Rejoignez un acteur de référence du conseil en Stratégie Data & IA !
Qui sommes-nous ?
AI Builders est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en Stratégie Data et Intelligence Artificielle, fondé en 2019 par Stéphane RODER, auteur du Guide Pratique de l’Intelligence Artificielle dans l’entreprise.
Notre mission : aider les entreprises à transformer leurs métiers et leurs processus grâce à la Data et à l’IA, de la stratégie jusqu’au passage à l’échelle.
Aujourd’hui, AI Builders s’est rapproché de Wavestone, cabinet de conseil international, pour unir la profondeur de son expertise Data & IA à la puissance d’un acteur majeur du conseil en transformation. Une nouvelle étape qui nous permet d’accompagner nos clients sur des transformations toujours plus ambitieuses, au croisement des enjeux business, technologiques et organisationnels.
Nous intervenons auprès de grands groupes du CAC 40 et du SBF120 sur leurs enjeux Data & IA les plus stratégiques.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
L’IA transforme profondément les entreprises. Chez AI Builders, vous êtes directement acteur de cette transformation en :
- Travaillant sur des projets Data & IA stratégiques, au cœur des transformations de nos clients ;
- Collaborant avec des Directions Générales, métiers et Chief Data Officers ;
- Développant une double compétence Conseil & Data/IA, à la croisée de la stratégie, du business et de la technologie ;
- Imaginant de nouveaux produits et usages, en réinventant les processus métier et l’expérience client grâce à l’IA.
Une culture d’expertise qui conserve son ADN
Rejoindre AI Builders, c’est intégrer une équipe de spécialistes passionnés par la Data et l’IA, tout en bénéficiant désormais de la force et des opportunités offertes par le rapprochement avec Wavestone :
- Une forte culture d’expertise et d’innovation autour de la Data et de l’IA ;
- Un environnement dynamique, collaboratif et bienveillant ;
- Des formations continues pour accélérer votre montée en compétences ;
- Des opportunités élargies grâce à la complémentarité entre l’expertise AI Builders et les savoir-faire de Wavestone.

Description du poste
Vos missions :
En tant que consultant(e) senior, vous serez impliqué(e) dans toutes les dimensions de nos projets :
- Accompagner les Directions Générales et les Chief Data Officers sur des missions stratégiques : définition de schémas directeurs, développement de nouvelles offres, optimisation des processus métiers, change management, acculturation
- Participer à la commercialisation de nos offres : avant-vente, élaboration de propositions commerciales, capitalisation de notre expertise interne
- Contribuer à l’innovation et au développement d’AI Builders via des analyses stratégiques, des benchmarks, des formations et des initiatives de développement interne

Vous êtes un(e) consultant(e) avec 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en transformation Data IA, digitale ou en stratégie, et vous avez à cœur de contribuer à des projets à fort impact stratégique ? Voici ce que nous recherchons :

- Un cadre de travail stimulant

Chez AI Builders, nous mettons un point d’honneur à vous faire évoluer. Grâce à notre onboarding sur-mesure et des formations internes tout au long de votre carrière, vous développerez rapidement un savoir-faire unique qui fera de vous un expert(e) reconnu(e) en Stratégie Data et IA.

Do you like helping companies unlock performance improvement opportunities and deliver profitable growth? Our Operations and Improvement team works with clients across all major sectors. The team works on strategy through to implementation on issues critical to the growth and prosperity of business operations across the world. Our typical client projects include enterprise wide cost reduction programs, supply chain network and logistics optimisation, manufacturing capacity improvement and scaling, designing and delivering the supply chains and manufacturing capabilities of tomorrow, driving incremental and transformational change as well as agile transformations.

- Analyse performance, identify improvement opportunities and design solutions
- Own deliverables and timelines as part of PMO support
- Collaborate with senior consultants to lead organizational change
- Help clients realize business benefits through improved processes and governance
We believe value is created through close collaboration with our clients. You will join an international environment that prioritizes teamwork, sparring and continuous learning so we can deliver outstanding work. We are therefore looking for someone with an open and curious approach to solving challenges and who is driven by acquiring new knowledge. Your employment with us starts with a thorough introduction. To support your development, you will from day one be assigned a manager and a buddy who, together with you, will prepare a development plan adapted to your skills and interests.

Inclusion & Diversity 
We believe that diversity makes us a stronger firm and look to employ people with different ideas, styles and skillsets. Description de l'entreprise
Rejoignez un acteur de référence du conseil en Stratégie Data & IA !
Qui sommes-nous ?
AI Builders est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en Stratégie Data et Intelligence Artificielle, fondé en 2019 par Stéphane RODER, auteur du Guide Pratique de l’Intelligence Artificielle dans l’entreprise.
Notre mission : aider les entreprises à transformer leurs métiers et leurs processus grâce à la Data et à l’IA, de la stratégie jusqu’au passage à l’échelle.
Aujourd’hui, AI Builders s’est rapproché de Wavestone, cabinet de conseil international, pour unir la profondeur de son expertise Data & IA à la puissance d’un acteur majeur du conseil en transformation. Une nouvelle étape qui nous permet d’accompagner nos clients sur des transformations toujours plus ambitieuses, au croisement des enjeux business, technologiques et organisationnels.
Nous intervenons auprès de grands groupes du CAC 40 et du SBF120 sur leurs enjeux Data & IA les plus stratégiques.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
L’IA transforme profondément les entreprises. Chez AI Builders, vous êtes directement acteur de cette transformation en :
- Travaillant sur des projets Data & IA stratégiques, au cœur des transformations de nos clients ;
- Collaborant avec des Directions Générales, métiers et Chief Data Officers ;
- Développant une double compétence Conseil & Data/IA, à la croisée de la stratégie, du business et de la technologie ;
- Imaginant de nouveaux produits et usages, en réinventant les processus métier et l’expérience client grâce à l’IA.
Une culture d’expertise qui conserve son ADN
Rejoindre AI Builders, c’est intégrer une équipe de spécialistes passionnés par la Data et l’IA, tout en bénéficiant désormais de la force et des opportunités offertes par le rapprochement avec Wavestone :
- Une forte culture d’expertise et d’innovation autour de la Data et de l’IA ;
- Un environnement dynamique, collaboratif et bienveillant ;
- Des formations continues pour accélérer votre montée en compétences ;
- Des opportunités élargies grâce à la complémentarité entre l’expertise AI Builders et les savoir-faire de Wavestone.

Vos missions :
Vous serez impliqué(e) dans toutes les dimensions du cabinet :
- Réalisation de missions de conseil pour le compte des Chief Data Officer et Direction de la stratégie des clients du cabinet : stratégie d’investissement Data IA sous forme de Schéma Directeur Data IA , nouvelles offres de service, augmentation de la performance de process et métiers, Data Management, acculturation, change management…
- Commercialisation de l’offre de conseil de AI Builders : avant-vente, proposition commerciale…
- Participation au développement interne de AI Builders : capitalisation, constitution des offres, analyses stratégiques, benchmarking, formations, afterwork
Rejoignez AI Builders et embrassez une carrière menant aux plus hautes fonctions de demain en devenant un(e) expert(e) de la Stratégie Data IA des entreprises !

- Vous disposez d’une première expérience en conseil en stratégie ou management dans un grand cabinet de conseil.

- Vous êtes d’un naturel sociable, savez faire preuve d’écoute attentive et disposez d’un bon sens de l’organisation
- Vous avez une appétence marquée pour les sujets liés aux transformations Data IA des entreprises et vous maîtrisez ou avez suivi un parcours académique sur le Machine Learning, le Deep Learning et leur l’apport en terme de performance pour l’entreprise.
- Vous parlez couramment le français et l’anglais afin de pouvoir intervenir sur des projets à l’étranger.
- Vous maîtrisez parfaitement la suite office : PowerPoint et Excel.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will be a key contributor to the growth and development of our Strategic Operations (SOP) practice-Source Tower as we offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients.

Working alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people, you will work alongside our clients to define and implement strategies that will deliver both short-term results and longer-term competitiveness in this ever-changing market environment.

Through unique hands-on experiences, you will broaden your knowledge across a breadth of topics while developing relationships with clients and colleagues across the firm. With the freedom to be yourself and recognition for what you bring to the table, you can put your purpose into action and help build a future that works for everyone, everywhere—as a Kearney Original.

Who you are

After nearly 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who don’t accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves.

We Want to Hear From You If You Are

Insightful, inquisitive, and collaborative.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Have functional experience in one or more of the following areas:
Strategic sourcing and category management
Procurement operating model design
Cost optimization and value capture
Supplier collaboration and risk management
Apply strong expertise in one or more core sourcing capabilities, with a broad understanding of the broader procurement landscape, including:
Category management
Strategic sourcing
Procurement and digital purchasing transformation
Supplier relationship management (SRM)
Vendor negotiation and contracting strategies
Apply procurement expertise across industries to improve efficiency, resilience, and innovation.
Contribute to thought leadership, tools, and methodologies that strengthen Kearney’s sourcing and procurement capabilities.

In Addition, We Look for Individuals with the Following Experience or Qualities

3–5 years of professional experience.
A master's degree, or an undergraduate degree with relevant work experience.
Experience working as a Management Consultant preferred.
Located near, or willing to relocate to, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Detroit, New York, San Francisco, or Washington, D.C.
This role requires approximately 50–80% travel, based on client and business needs.

What we can offer you:

Every day, our people make a difference for our clients, communities, and colleagues. We support them with a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including:

· Generous retirement/pension savings contributions

· Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and immediate family

· Gym membership discounts

· Non-partner equity-based awards (for consulting managers and above)

· Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities

· Personalized career pathways, including mobility programs, flexible work arrangements, and externships

Senior Business Analyst base salary - $123,000 - $127,000: However, it is important to note that at Kearney, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role. Individual salaries within each range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, office location, knowledge and skills. Kearney reviews compensation regularly and may adjust base salaries to reflect market competitiveness. In addition to salary, individuals may be eligible for a discretionary performance bonus. Our full suite of benefits includes paid time off, paid sick time off, 401(k) match and profit sharing, medical, dental and vision coverage, healthcare concierge, backup child/adult care, annual employer HSA contribution, home office stipend, subsidized Gympass and annual wellness program, and leaves of absence when needed to support employees’ physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

Read more about our benefits and a career at Kearney.com/careers.

Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination
Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. - Deal with the day to day queries from the WSP in India Team, ensuring that relevant information is available on time for construction activity
- Report to the WSP in India Team in association with the Local CRC Head of MEP any variance between the works constructed and the design intent
- Project manage commissions from the WSP in India Team, using applicable project management tools
- Lead the design process and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme.

ZS is seeking a Decision Analytics Associate Consultant to join the Supply Chain and Manufacturing practice, with a focus on pharmaceutical CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) drug development. This role is designed for professionals with 2–3 years of hands-on pharmaceutical experience who are ready to apply their domain expertise and quantitative modeling skills to digitalize and analytically transform CMC operations for global pharma clients. - Leverage quantitative skills to derive answers to clients' ongoing business analytics and reporting questions
- Work collaboratively with clients to ascertain the client's specific business information needs
- Upskill on concepts relevant to solve client problems across modalities
- Execute a specific plan for analyzing the data necessary to secure solutions to clients' particular business information need(s)
- Discuss and determine with clients which specific data may be best utilized in order to perform the necessary analysis
- Evaluate, assess and analyze the data necessary to provide solutions to the client's particular business information needs

- Gain immediate familiarity with client's internal processes
- Develop expertise within a client analytics area
- Be available for clients during regular working hours
- Build/use first-principles models (e.g., CFD, DEM) to simulate and optimize pharmaceutical manufacturing unit operations such as blending, granulation, coating, drying, and tableting
- Develop/use AI/ML models for predictive analytics, process optimization, and quality prediction across CMC workflows — including CQA prediction, CPP sensitivity analysis, and batch outcome forecasting
- Translate model outputs into actionable client insights to support process development, scale-up, and tech transfer decisions
- Support model validation, verification, and documentation aligned with Quality by Design (QbD) principles and regulatory expectations (e.g., ICH Q8/Q9/Q10)
- Collaborate with cross-functional client teams (Formulation, Process Engineering, Quality, Regulatory) to identify and prioritize modeling opportunities across drug substance and drug product development
- Advance problem-solving skills and improve ZS’s capabilities; 
- Guide and mentor Associates on teams.

- Hands-on experience building/using first-principles (e.g., CFD, DEM) and AI/ML models for pharma process development for at least one modality
- Experience developing and managing production-grade codes for models, including models' lifecycle management
- Knowledge of key concepts including unit operations, processes, Quality by Design (QbD), tech transfer, process validation, quality attributes, and regulatory milestones across pharma development
- Ability to translate the knowledge of concepts in one modality to other modalities, if needed

- Experience presenting to senior leaders, executives, and audiences with CMC backgrounds
- Ability to lead multiple workstreams and demonstrate effective time and project management skills
- Capability to simplify complex concepts into easily understandable frameworks and presentations

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
Your Profile
As a Consultant in our Business Technology practice, you will support clients in shaping and executing business, IT, and digital transformation strategies. You will work on projects that span business strategy, IT strategy, target operating model design, scaled Agile transformation, digital operating models, and IT cost optimization. Your role will involve helping clients align their business and technology capabilities to drive performance, innovation, and resilience.
You will collaborate with senior stakeholders, contribute to strategic analysis, and help design future-ready operating models and governance structures. This role is ideal for early-career professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems through a blend of strategic thinking, digital innovation, and technology insight.
What you will do:
- Support the development of business, IT, and digital strategies aligned to client goals and market dynamics
- Contribute to the design of target operating models, including organizational structure, governance, and capability frameworks
- Assist in agile@scale assessments and transformation planning across business and IT functions
- Analyze IT and business cost structures, identify optimization opportunities, and support business cases for change
- Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and data analysis to inform strategic recommendations
- Prepare client deliverables including presentations, reports, and models with clear insights and actionable recommendations
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business, technology, and delivery stakeholders
- Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in business, IT, and digital transformation
Your Profile
- 1–4 years of experience in management consulting, business strategy, digital transformation, or IT strategy roles
- Exposure to business and digital transformation, operating model design, agile transformation, or cost optimization projects
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex issues
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging stakeholders
- Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and managing multiple priorities
- Familiarity with frameworks such as TOGAF, SAFe, ITIL, or business model canvas is a plus
- Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or related field; advanced degrees or certifications are a bonus
- Open to travel as required for client engagements (~20%), while primarily based in Singapore or Hong Kong
What You'll Love about Working Here?
- We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance
- At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities
- Exposure to top global companies working with Capgemini (145 of the Fortune 500 companies)
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
Why this role matters?
As an ESMS Specialist, you will support ERM’s global consulting delivery by developing and implementing Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) that are aligned with international standards such as but not limited to IFC PS, WB ESS (knowledge of European, African and Asian IFI’s standard are a plus). You will work within the Impact Assessment capability of the CPD service line, partnering with regional consultants and global client teams to deliver robust, standards-compliant management systems. This role is critical to the quality, consistency, and international compliance of ERM’s environmental and social advisory delivery.
What your impact is?
- Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) are developed and implemented in line with IFC Performance Standard 1 (PS1) and other relevant international standards.
- Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs), manuals, action plans, and policies are delivered to a high, audit-ready standard.
- Regional consulting teams and clients receive timely, specialist ESMS support that strengthens delivery quality and efficiency.
- Management systems remain current and are continuously improved to reflect evolving international requirements and lender expectations.
- Client projects consistently meet regulatory, lender, and international governance requirements for environmental and social management.
What will you bring?
- Strong working knowledge of relevant international standards and associated lender frameworks.
- Experience developing and implementing Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) within a consulting, sustainability, or industry environment.
- Proven ability to produce ESMPs, management manuals, action plans, and policies to a high standard.
- Proficiency in English (essential) together with French, Italian, or Spanish — priority given to French speakers.
- Experience working with global teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing capability.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver to deadlines.
Preferred skills & competencies
- Experience implementing ESMS across sectors such as infrastructure, energy, or industrial development.
- Exposure to global delivery or shared service environments.
- Familiarity with additional international frameworks (e.g., the Equator Principles, IFC Performance Standards 2–8, World Bank Group EHS Guidelines).
- Experience using automation or AI-enabled tools.
- Relevant certifications or advanced qualifications in environmental and social management.
Key responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) aligned with international standards (IFC PS1, ESMPs, manuals, action plans, and policies).
- Prepare, maintain, and update Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs) and supporting management-system documentation.
- Advise regional consultants and clients on the application of international environmental and social standards.
- Review and continuously improve management systems to ensure ongoing compliance with international and lender requirements.
- Collaborate with global project teams to ensure consistent, high-quality, and efficient delivery.

jd_text:
ERM is seeking a motivated Environmental Consultant to join our global advisory and sustainability consulting firm. This role is to support expansion of ERM Singapore as the Southeast Asia (SEA) Hub and will be based at our Singapore office.
As an entry level consultant, you will gain exposure to a range of environmental, social, and health impact assessment assignments to build a sustainable business both nationally and regionally, while networking with ERM's technical teams to share best practices across the industry. 
Responsibilities: 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the successful delivery of Sustainable Ops, Capital Project Delivery, Corporate Sustainability and Climate Change, Transaction Services, and Liability and Liability Portfolio Management & Remediation projects.
- Assist in project planning, execution, and monitoring to ensure timely and high-quality project outcomes.
- Conduct environment and social-related field work.
- Perform environmental compliance assessments and implement follow-up corrective actions to ensure compliance national and local regulations.
- Provide general environmental compliance support to clients, including on-site assistance, as needed.
- Compile and evaluate data and assist in report preparation.
- Perform project tasks within scope/budget/schedule expectations and ensure quality standards on project deliverables.
- Support client liaison and assist in the preparation of presentation materials.
- Support the management and coordination of specialist subcontractors.
- Support ERM Partners-in-Charge and Project Managers to deliver exceptional client value on projects.
- Provide business value based on a strong understanding of clients’ needs and raising the profile of ERM’s capabilities within key client organizations.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's and/or master's in environmental studies, engineering, social science, planning, geography or related disciplines.
- 3+ years of relevant experience.
- Flexibility to travel.
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision or as part of a team.
- Ability to identify solutions to resolve conflicts.
- Effective English written/verbal communication
- Good organization/analytical skills.
- Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, speak persuasively and develop rapport internally and externally.
- Ability to manage varying priorities and multiple tasks while functioning within a cohesive delivery team to meet concurrent deadlines on multiple projects.
- Positive outlook, collaborative, and driven by the success of ERM as a global company.
- Experience assisting with preparing reports, letters, memos, standard forms, and agreements.
- Deadline oriented and adaptable to diverse environments (i.e. construction work areas, inclement weather, etc.).

jd_text:
ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
Why this role matters?
As a Socioeconomic Consultant, you will support ERM’s global Impact Assessment teams by contributing social and human rights expertise to environmental and social assessments across a range of sectors and geographies. Working within the Capital Project Delivery Impact Assessment capability, you will help project teams identify social risks and impacts, apply international standards, and develop robust, practical recommendations for clients. This role is critical to ensuring the quality, consistency, and efficiency of social and human rights inputs across ERM’s global project portfolio.
What your impact is?
- Support the preparation of social and human rights inputs for environmental and social impact assessments, human rights assessments, due diligence reviews, and management plans.
- Contribute to the review and analysis of project documentation against international standards, including IFC Performance Standards, EBRD Performance Requirements, Equator Principles, and other relevant good international industry practice.
- Assist project teams in identifying social risks, human rights considerations, stakeholder engagement needs, and mitigation measures across different sectors and geographies.
- Help prepare clear, well-structured deliverables, including baseline summaries, impact assessment sections, stakeholder engagement materials, and action plans.
- Support consistent and efficient delivery across regions by working closely with senior consultants and technical specialists.
- Contribute to high-quality client outputs by applying strong research, analytical, writing, and organizational skills.
What will you bring?
- Academic background in social sciences, human rights, international development, sustainability, environmental/social management, law, political science, anthropology, sociology, or a related field.
- Initial experience or strong interest in social performance, human rights, impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, or responsible business practices.
- Understanding of international standards and frameworks relevant to social and human rights matters, such as IFC Performance Standards, EBRD Performance Requirements, Equator Principles, UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, and/or OECD guidance.
- Strong research, analytical, and written communication skills, with the ability to summarize complex information clearly and accurately.
- Ability to support multiple workstreams, manage priorities, and deliver quality outputs within agreed deadlines.
- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn from senior technical specialists.
- Ability to work effectively with international and cross-functional teams.
- Ability to travel to project sites in remote locations.
- Fluency in English, plus French, Italian, or Spanish. Priority will be given to candidates with French and/or Italian language skills.
Preferred skills & competencies
- Exposure to international development finance institutions, lender requirements, or sustainability advisory work.
- Familiarity with labour and working conditions, community health and safety, land acquisition, indigenous peoples, cultural heritage.
- Experience working in consulting, international organizations, or development agencies.
- Ability to work in additional languages relevant to ERM’s international project portfolio.
Key responsibilities
- Support senior consultants in preparing social and human rights deliverables for international client projects.
- Conduct desk-based research, document reviews, and gap analyses against applicable international standards and client requirements.
- Assist in drafting sections of social and human rights assessments, stakeholder engagement plans, management plans, corrective action plans, and related technical outputs.
- Contribute to the identification of social risks, human rights impacts, affected stakeholders, vulnerable groups, and appropriate mitigation or management measures.
- Support the preparation of project materials, including interview guides, stakeholder mapping tools, meeting notes, data summaries, and presentation materials.
- Help maintain consistency, quality, and traceability across project documentation and deliverables.
- Collaborate with regional consultants, technical specialists, and CDH colleagues to support timely and efficient project delivery.
- Participate in internal learning, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement activities related to social performance and human rights consulting.

jd_text:
Om rollen
Rollen är en unik möjlighet att leda och vidareutveckla Capgemini Invents försvarsaffär i Sverige, med särskilt fokus på Försvarsmakten, FMV och andra försvarsmyndigheter. Du kommer att spela en central roll i att stödja det svenska försvarets pågående förmågetillväxt genom strategisk rådgivning, transformation och innovation. Du blir en central partner till våra kunder inom försvarssektorn och driver kritiska initiativ som bidrar till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga. Uppdraget innebär att du sätter dig in i kundernas verksamhet och behov, identifierar möjligheter och utformar lösningar med stöd av Capgemini Groups starka globala kapacitet inom rådgivning, försvarskunnande, teknologi, data och AI. Du har ett övergripande ansvar utveckla kundrelationen, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och säkerställa långsiktigt och lönsamt samarbete med våra nyckelkunder inom försvarssegmentet. Genom att stärka partnerskapen och skapa tydliga, mätbara resultat bidrar du direkt till våra kunders framgång och till ett starkare och säkrare Sverige. Detta är ett av våra mest prioriterade områden och rollen har därför hög synlighet och stor strategisk betydelse.
Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden
- Bygga och utveckla strategiska kundrelationer inom försvarssektorn.
- Fördjupa dig i försvarsmyndigheternas uppdrag, förutsättningar och behov samt förstå hur Capgemini Invent bäst kan bidra till att skapa verklig effekt och stärkt svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Fungera som betrodd rådgivare till tjänstemän, chefer och ledande beslutsfattare samt utmana och vägleda deras strategiska riktning.
- Driva kommersiell tillväxt och utveckla försvarssegmentet långsiktigt.
- Leda affärsutveckling, från att identifiera nya möjligheter till att forma erbjudanden och vinna strategiska uppdrag.
- Expandera och utveckla försvarskonton samt bygga långsiktiga partnerskap med fokus på konkreta och mätbara resultat.
- Designa och leda transformationsprogram inom områden som verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering, data och analys, AI samt större förmågehöjande initiativ.
- Samarbeta med tvärfunktionella experter och leveransteam inom Capgemini Group för att erbjuda integrerade och innovativa lösningar.
- Bidra till, samarbeta med och dra nytta av Capgeminis internationella försvarsexpertis genom Defense Europe.
- Bidra till att forma framtidens försvarsförmåga genom att driva dialogen kring områden som digital suveränitet, AI, cyberförsvar, interoperabilitet, data och försörjningsberedskap.
- Representera Capgemini Invent i försvars- och myndighetsekosystemet genom ledningsdialoger, konferenser, seminarier och branschforum.
- Leda, coacha och utveckla konsulter på alla nivåer.
- Främja en inkluderande, samarbetsinriktad och innovativ kultur inom Capgemini Invent.
Din profil
Du är en erfaren ledare med stark bakgrund inom offentlig sektor, försvarssektorn eller närliggande områden samt lång erfarenhet av konsultverksamhet och komplexa transformationer. Vi söker dig som har:
- Omfattande erfarenhet från statlig verksamhet eller försvarsrelaterade organisationer med god förståelse för styrning, regelverk, ekonomistyrning och beslutsprocesser.
- Stark kommersiell drivkraft och dokumenterat resultat inom affärsutveckling, kundansvar och långsiktig tillväxt.
- Etablerat nätverk och dokumenterad erfarenhet av att navigera komplexa beslutsmiljöer inom försvars- eller statlig sektor.
- Tryggt ledarskap och mycket god kommunikationsförmåga, med förmåga att påverka och bygga förtroende på högsta nivå.
- Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda komplexa transformationsprogram, exempelvis inom digitalisering, datadriven verksamhetsutveckling, organisationsförändring eller större strategiska initiativ.
- Akademisk examen inom exempelvis ekonomi, statsvetenskap, samhällsvetenskap, teknik eller motsvarande. Officersutbildning eller erfarenhet från Försvarsmakten, FMV eller annan försvarsrelaterad verksamhet är också meriterande.
- Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
- För rollen krävs svenskt medborgarskap och möjlighet att genomgå samt godkännas i säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen.
Varför Capgemini Invent
Att bli en del av Capgemini Invent innebär att ansluta till en global gemenskap av innovatörer, strateger, teknologer och förändringsledare som formar framtidens samhälle. Vi erbjuder:
- Meningsfull påverkan: Leda transformationer för några av Sveriges viktigaste myndigheter och bidra till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Innovation i stor skala: Arbeta med spjutspetskompetens inom AI, data, cybersäkerhet, digital suveränitet och framtidens försvarsförmågor.
- Karriärutveckling: Tillgång till världsledande utbildningar, ledarskapsprogram, mentorskap och globala karriärmöjligheter.
- En samarbetsdriven kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av marknadens främsta experter i en kultur som värdesätter samarbete, entreprenörskap och kontinuerligt lärande.
- Global räckvidd, lokal påverkan: Kombinera styrkan från ett globalt nätverk med möjligheten att göra verklig skillnad för svenska kunder och samhället i stort.
Ansökan
I linje med vår tillitsbaserade kultur erbjuder Capgemini Invent ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Rollen är baserad på vårt centralt belägna kontor i Stockholm, med resor till kund vid behov.
Befattning och ansvarsnivå baseras på en helhetsbedömning av din erfarenhet och kompetens.
Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av giltig ID-handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan komma att genomföras där så är relevant.
Om Capgemini 
Capgemini är en global partner inom affärs- och tekniktransformation som hjälper organisationer att påskynda övergången till en digital och hållbar värld, och samtidigt gör skillnad för företag och samhälle. Det är en ansvarsfull och mångsidig organisation med 423 400 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Med ett starkt arv som sträcker sig över 55 år tillbaka har Capgemini sina kunders förtroende att hjälpa dem frigöra värdet av teknik för att tillgodose hela deras affärsbehov. Capgemini levererar helhetslösningar som utnyttjar styrkan från strategi och design till teknik. Allt drivet av en marknadsledande kapacitet inom AI, generativ AI, moln och data, kombinerat med en djup branschexpertis och ett ekosystem av partners. År 2025 rapporterade Capgemini Group globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro.

About the team
We are looking for social researchers/public policy consultants to join a well-established practice within ICF that develops, analyses and evaluates UK Government policies and programmes across priority social policy domains, including education/employment, communities, youth and families. ICF’s clients include government departments and agencies such as the Department for Education, the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government and the Department for Work and Pensions – as well as local government and leading charities. From day one, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a varied range of influential research projects across the UK. We are particularly interested in hearing from people with a background or interest in sport and active leisure, as well as broader social policy topics such as youth inclusion and employment.
Your main responsibilities will be to:
- Perform research and analysis on public policy issues and programmes for public and third sector clients, by:
- Carrying out research and analysing / summarising academic and policy literature.
- Conducting face to face, telephone and video interviews, writing up interviews and focus groups, and carrying out qualitative analysis using a variety of tools and software.
- Analysing quantitative data using a variety of tools and software.
- Generating insightful findings, preparing descriptive and analytical texts and data visualisations.
- Providing research and administrative support to other team members.

- Qualifications relevant to social policy or research methods (graduate or postgraduate, for example but not limited to social sciences, economics or health economics, applied statistics, geography, political science, service design, psychology or sociology, public policy research or public administration).

- Excellent oral and written English.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Intermediate or advanced computer user skills related to carrying out research and data analysis.

- Skills in editing or proofreading other people’s written work.
- Experience in undertaking evaluations of projects or programmes.
- Knowledge of the work of UK government departments.

- Ability to write skilfully and accurately summarise and synthesise information and evidence from a wide range of sources.
- Highly developed interpersonal / communication skills, and ability to work with a multidisciplinary team spread across the UK.
- Sound research and business ethics.
- Ability to manage own time and be flexible to handle multiple priorities, managing a varied workload to meet deadlines.

The Senior Consultant – Nature and Environment will support the delivery and growth of ICF’s portfolio of work for Defra and its arm’s-length bodies, with a particular focus on natural environment policy. The role is designed for someone who can combine strong project management with relevant technical, research and policy expertise. The postholder will manage multiple projects, contribute directly to technical delivery, and support the mobilisation of new work across biodiversity, nature recovery, protected sites and related environmental policy areas.
Key responsibilities
Technical delivery – nature and environment
- Contribute technical expertise to monitoring, evaluation, research and learning projects in the natural environment field.
- Support the design of evaluation questions, theories of change, monitoring frameworks, research methods and evidence synthesis approaches.
- Undertake and oversee qualitative and quantitative research, analysis and reporting, ensuring outputs are robust, practical and accessible to policy audiences.
- Apply knowledge of UK environmental policy and delivery contexts to interpret evidence and develop useful conclusions and recommendations.
- Provide technical review and quality assurance for the work of junior colleagues and delivery partners.
Project and delivery management
- Manage a portfolio of small and medium-sized nature- and environment-related projects, taking responsibility for delivery planning, resourcing, budgets, risks, quality and client reporting.
- Mobilise new projects quickly, establishing proportionate governance, clear roles, realistic workplans and effective project controls.
- Coordinate multidisciplinary ICF teams and delivery partners, ensuring inputs are integrated and deadlines are met.
- Monitor progress, dependencies, risks and financial performance, taking timely corrective action where required.
- Maintain clear and constructive client relationships, provide concise progress updates and manage changes to scope or delivery expectations
Business development and portfolio support
- Contribute to project plans and bids, including shaping methods, workplans, resourcing and budgets.
- Work flexibly across ICF’s environment portfolio, supporting priority projects and emerging client needs.
- Help identify opportunities to retain and grow nature and environment work within ICF.
- Support the development of reusable methods, tools, guidance and learning across the team.
- Coach junior staff, supporting their technical and project delivery development.
Qualifications and experience
- Degree or equivalent professional experience in environmental policy, ecology, environmental science, social research, evaluation, economics or a related discipline.
- Relevant consulting, research, policy or programme delivery experience, with demonstrable responsibility for managing projects or substantial workstreams.
- Knowledge of UK natural environment policy and delivery, such as biodiversity, nature recovery, protected sites, land management or environmental monitoring.
- Experience of monitoring, evaluation, applied research or evidence-based policy work.
- Strong project management skills, including planning, resourcing, risk management, budget oversight and quality assurance.
- Ability to contribute technically while maintaining oversight of delivery, commercial performance and client requirements.
- Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear client-ready outputs.
- Experience working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and external partners.
Desirable experience
- Experience delivering work for Defra, its arm’s-length bodies or other UK public-sector clients.
- Experience of theory-based, process, impact or value-for-money evaluation.
- Knowledge of biodiversity targets, nature recovery, protected sites or place-based environmental delivery.
- Experience managing supplier or partner inputs within a consultancy delivery model.
- Experience contributing to competitive proposals and developing costed workplans.
Personal qualities
- Delivery-focused, organised and able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment.
- Collaborative and pragmatic, with the judgement to know when to resolve issues directly and when to escalate.
- Confident working with multidisciplinary teams, clients and delivery partners.
- Committed to quality, inclusion, learning and continuous improvement.
Additional points
- The role is expected to combine project management with substantive technical contribution; it is not a dedicated non-technical PM position.
- The postholder may work across several thematic areas and projects, depending on demand and subject-matter fit.
- The role will support both secured delivery and the development and mobilisation of new work.

À propos du poste
Nous recrutons un(e) Consultant(e) Senior Eau pour développer et renforcer notre expertise en gestion de l’eau en France. Si vous maîtrisez les réglementations ICPE, les schémas SDAGE/SAGE, les questions de prélèvements et de rejets ainsi que les directives européennes relatives à l’eau, et que vous aimez accompagner les clients dans la résolution de défis concrets liés à la ressource en eau, ce poste est fait pour vous.

- Expérience des référentiels AWS ou de méthodologies de gestion durable de l’eau équivalentes.
- Excellentes compétences relationnelles et capacité à intervenir de manière autonome auprès des clients.

- Strong client‑facing skills and ability to deliver autonomously.
- Fluency in French and professional English.
What we Offer

- A collaborative team that values expertise, curiosity, and good humour.

ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.

CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes. 
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
Why this role matters?
As a Wind Resource & Energy Yield Specialist, you will contribute to ERM's global renewable energy consulting practice by delivering high-quality wind resource assessments, energy yield assessments, and technical advisory services. Working within the Technical Due Diligence team, you will support wind energy projects throughout the project lifecycle, including site screening, development, financing, acquisition, construction, and operations. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across North America and EMEA to help clients evaluate project performance, understand technical risks, and make informed investment decisions.
What your impact is?
- Deliver bankable wind resource and energy yield assessments for utility-scale wind projects.
- Support technical due diligence assignments for project financing, mergers and acquisitions, and portfolio evaluations.
- Develop and optimize wind turbine layouts to maximize energy production while considering environmental, engineering, and permitting constraints.
- Analyze meteorological data and operational performance data to determine energy yield and identify risks and opportunities with project energyine energy yield and identify risks and opportunities with project energy yield performance.
- Provide inputs as needed for design, environmental studies, and project economics.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of ERM's energy yield methodologies, tools, and best practices.
What will you bring?
- A solid academic background in atmospheric sciences or related engineering field (Meteorology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering).
- Minimum 5 years of technical consulting, engineering, or operational experience during your career within the energy / infrastructure sectors.
- Strong technical skills and analytical skills.
- Experience performing wind data quality control, validation, and meteorological data analysis.
- Familiarity with Measure-Correlate-Predict (MCP) methodologies and long-term resource correction techniques.
- Understanding of wind farm loss calculations including wake losses, electrical losses, turbine performance, environmental losses, and availability assumptions.
- Familiarity with uncertainty assessments and P50/P75/P90 energy production estimates.
- Knowledge of industry standards such as IEC 61400-15 and wind resource assessment best practices. 
- Experience working with met mast, lidar, and reanalysis datasets.
Preferred qualifications, skills & competencies
- Experience preparing lender's technical advisor or independent engineer style energy yield assessments.
- Experience supporting project financing, acquisitions, or technical due diligence activities.
- Knowledge of both onshore and offshore wind resource assessments.
- Familiarity with CFD-based flow modelling and mesoscale-to-microscale wind resource modelling approaches.
- Experience analysing operational wind farm performance and SCADA datasets.
- Working knowledge of solar energy yield assessment methodologies.
- Python programming and workflow automation experience.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare technical reports, client presentations, and due diligence deliverables.
- Support proposal development through scope preparation, effort estimation, and technical inputs.
- Participate in client meetings and respond to technical questions.
- Review and QA/QC technical analyses and deliverables.
- Evaluate technical risks and opportunities associated with wind projects, including resource uncertainty, technology selection, operational performance, and project bankability.
- Collaborate with global teams and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality project outcomes.
- Contribute to methodology development, automation initiatives, and process improvements.
- Support the training and development of junior analysts where appropriate.

Insights & Analytics Associate Consultant
ZS’s Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions that help them tackle complex business challenges. Our teams leverage advanced analytics, data science, and problem-solving techniques to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations.
For this opportunity, we are looking for an Associate Consultant with a strong advanced analytics and data science background, ideally within healthcare or life sciences. This role blends traditional Decision Analytics consulting with hands-on advanced analytics and modeling. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their business challenges, determine the right analytical approach, and translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
What You’ll Do
- Approach complex client business problems using advanced analytics, data science, and structured problem solving
- Lead and support the development of advanced analytical and machine learning models to address client business questions
- Translate business challenges into appropriate analytical approaches and modeling solutions
- Leverage large and complex datasets to identify trends, generate insights, and inform client decision-making
- Apply knowledge of pharmaceutical and healthcare data sources to support analyses and recommendations
- Design and execute custom analyses using appropriate statistical, analytical, and data science techniques
- Take ownership of analytical workstreams and operate independently while collaborating closely with broader project teams
- Synthesize complex analytical findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations
- Develop presentations and communicate analytical results directly to clients, including audiences that may not have technical backgrounds
- Build strong client relationships and serve as a key point of contact on aspects of projects
- Provide project status updates and help drive workstreams toward key milestones and deliverables
- Guide and mentor Associates and other junior team members

- Consulting experience, ideally involving advanced analytics, data science, or analytics-driven strategy
- Demonstrated experience building and leading advanced analytics models
- Experience with machine learning models and techniques
- Strong ability to connect advanced analytics and modeling to broader business problems and client objectives

- Strong communication and presentation skills, particularly the ability to explain complex analytical concepts and findings in a clear, business-focused way
- Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous business questions
- High motivation, maturity, and personal initiative
- Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset
- Collaborative, client-first approach and ability to work effectively in teams
- Fluency in English

- Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

jd_text:
Chez Capgemini Invent, nous croyons que l'innovation est le moteur du changement. En tant que consultants en transformation digitale, nous combinons nos capacités stratégiques, créatives et scientifiques, en collaborant étroitement avec nos clients pour leur fournir des solutions de pointes. Rejoignez-nous pour conduire une transformation adaptée aux défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain.
Lieu : Paris ou Toulouse
Vos missions
L’entité Aerospace & Defense accompagne les grands acteurs de l’aéronautique, du spatial et de la défense dans leurs projets de transformation digitale, durable et opérationnelle. Nos équipes interviennent sur des problématiques variées telles que le ramp-up industriel, la continuité numérique, la conformité règlementaire, l’optimisation de processus industriel, la sustainability.
En tant que consultant junior, vous accompagnerez les équipes sur des problématiques de stratégie, d’organisation et d’efficacité opérationnelle.
Vos responsabilités au sein d'une équipe projet et au contact du client seront :
- de collecter et d’analyser des données, via la conduite d’entretiens ou l’animation d’ateliers de co-construction chez le client,
- de participer à la présentation à nos clients des recommandations stratégiques identifiées avec eux,
- et de vous investir dans la vie interne du cabinet (recrutement, formations ; exemples : développement de contenu sectoriel et technologiques, développement personnel, prise de parole en public etc..).
Votre profil
- Diplômé d'école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou d’université, avec un vif intérêt pour les problématiques de transformation des entreprises et d’innovation digitale ; 
- Appétence particulière pour l’aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense ;
- Maîtrise courante de l’anglais et du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ; 
- Curiosité intellectuelle marquée et forte capacité d’adaptation dans des environnements variés.
Quelques raisons de nous rejoindre
- Avantages groupe : bénéficiez d’un ensemble d’avantages tels que les primes de cooptation, tickets restaurant, ainsi que des activités sociales et culturelles variées proposées par le CSE. Des dispositifs d’accompagnement à la parentalité, comme le temps partiel à 90% pendant les vacances scolaires, sont également disponibles, ainsi que de nombreux autres avantages issus de nos accords collectifs.
- Qualité de vie au travail : profitez d’un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, d’une possibilité de télétravailler (en France), ainsi que des dispositifs de santé et bien-être (ligne d'écoute, plateforme dédiée...).
- Environnement inclusif : rejoignez des réseaux engagés comme Women@Capgemini, Parents@Capgemini, OUTfront ou CapAbility, et évoluez dans un cadre certifié EDGE+ et reconnu par le Bloomberg Gender Equality Index.
- Happy Trainees : notre engagement envers les jeunes talents est reconnu dans le classement HappyTrainees, preuve que chez nous, les stagiaires et alternants ne viennent pas juste apprendre… ils viennent s’épanouir !
Nos engagements et priorités
Le groupe Capgemini encourage une culture inclusive au sein d’un cadre multiculturel et handi-accueillant. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez un collectif qui valorise la diversité, développe le potentiel de ses talents, s’engage dans des initiatives solidaires avec ses partenaires et se mobilise pour réduire son impact environnemental sur l’ensemble de ses sites ainsi qu’auprès de ses clients.
Capgemini Invent est la marque d’innovation digitale, de design et de transformation du groupe Capgemini. Etablie dans plus de 30 studios et plus de 60 dans le monde, elle compte une équipe de plus de 12 500 experts en stratégie, data scientists, concepteurs de produits et d’expériences ou encore experts en marques et en technologie qui développent de nouveaux services digitaux, produits, expériences et modèles d’affaire pour une croissance durable.
Get The Future You Want* | www.capgemini.com/fr
