At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Job Summary:
Join one of the fastest growing transaction advisory services practices in the country, where your talent and efforts are valued. Thrive in BDO’s entrepreneurial environment with an innovative and flat organizational structure. Be challenged based on your abilities and not your title. Be part of the number one middle market deals team and truly experience the opportunity of being an immediate contributor with real opportunities for career advancement. Work with industry leaders, technical experts and most importantly, people you enjoy spending time with. While BDO prides itself on the Firm’s work quality, it equally values work/life fit for its professionals, allowing them to focus on what’s important to them outside the office.
The Transaction Experienced Advisory Services Senior Associate will be responsible for managing financial, accounting and operational due diligence engagements for both strategic and financial buyers throughout the USA.
Job Duties:
 - Prepares data book, reconciles company financial statements generates financial tables and analyses for due diligence report
 - Analyzes financial forecasts, historical earnings, assets and liabilities of target client
 - Performs industry and company research
 - Collects information from all available sources related to the target client’s business
 - Conducts on-site and / or phone interviews with C-level personnel or target client to gather additional information in support of the financial analysis
 - Identifies and proposes appropriate resolutions to critical issues related to the M&A process
 - Manages the relationship and information flow between BDO and the target client
 - Partners with Transactional Services Senior Manager and Principal/Director to identify and pursue business development opportunities 
 - Researches and develops proposal documents and may participate in presentations in pursuit of acquiring new clients
 - Other duties as required
Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
Education:
 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or Finance, required
 - MBA, preferred
Experience:
 - Four (4) or more years of public accounting experience, required
 - One (1) or more years of prior TAS experience, preferred
 - Prior experience interacting and working directly with C-level personnel, preferred
License/Certifications:
 - CPA, CPA candidate, or CA, preferred 
Software:
 - Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suites, specifically Word, Excel and PowerPoint – strong modeling skills, required
 - Prior exposure utilizing IDEA, preferred 
Language:
 - N/A
Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, specifically business writing aptitude
 - Ability to interact with and adapt communication style to successfully convey messaging and objectives to all levels of management 
 - Capable of initiating and maintaining solid relationships with all levels of client personnel, as well as utilizing network and industry relationships to identify business development opportunities
 - Capable of working in a demanding, deadline-driven environment either independently or within a team dynamic while effectively managing unexpected issues and/or questions in a professional manner 
 - Ability to analyze large volumes of data to identify potential issues and propose the most appropriate resolutions to benefit the buyer 
 - Required to maintain the highly confidential nature of information
 - Excellent project management skills with ability to produce quality work project with an attention to detail
 - Knowledgeable of technical accounting areas such as US GAAP and SEC reporting
 - Knowledge of IFRS desirable
 - Ability to travel as needed
 Individual salaries that are offered to a candidate are determined after consideration of numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and geography.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. About the Job You’re Considering
As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.
The Process Excellence team helps clients improve how work gets done across core enterprise processes by combining process design, process mining, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled / agentic approaches to drive measurable business outcomes. The work is practical and value-focused: identifying inefficiencies, surfacing root causes through data, redesigning workflows, improving control and performance, and building roadmaps that translate operational pain points into real transformation. It is a strong fit for people who like solving complex business problems in a structured, evidence-based way and who can connect AI, intelligent automation, and process insight to broader enterprise transformation.
Your Role
As a consultant you’ll help clients improve core enterprise processes using process mining, analytics, and intelligent automation. This is practical transformation: finding what’s broken, quantifying the value, and building a roadmap for improvement - often with GenAI as an accelerant, not a gimmick.
You will:
· Document workflows and identify improvement and automation opportunities
· Support process mining and process discovery initiatives (data prep, analysis, insights)
· Build performance reporting (KPIs, dashboards, trend analysis) to quantify impact
· Support automation backlogs and transformation roadmaps tied to business value
· Support workshops and synthesis into clear recommendations
· Track emerging GenAI/automation trends and translate into applicable use cases
Your Skills + Experience
You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI‑enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI‑augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done. 
The Process Excellence team helps clients improve how work gets done across core enterprise processes by combining process design, process mining, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled / agentic approaches to drive measurable business outcomes. As a consultant you’ll help clients improve core enterprise processes using process mining, analytics, and intelligent automation. You will: 
- Document workflows and identify improvement and automation opportunities

- Support automation backlogs and transformation roadmaps tied to business value

As a Senior Consultant, you will have substantial expertise in Strategic Finance Delivery, whilst also being able to work flexibly across the wider Enterprise Model & Strategy portfolio. In this role you will contribute to the practice as follows: 
- Lead the delivery of large and complex Strategic Finance Improvement or transformation projects, collaborating with clients and teams to rapidly define business challenges and shape actionable solutions grounded in strategic thinking and evidence-based insights. 
- Develop and present meaningful recommendations, ensuring they are practical, robust, and withstand client scrutiny while leveraging the latest strategic transformation trends.

.

- Experience contributing to service redesign or transformation programmes, particularly those enhancing customer or user experience through digital tools and capabilities.

- Experience helping to shape compelling value propositions, proposals, or thought leadership that drives growth.

Currently progressing toward qualification and on track to complete within the next 12 months.

About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 13,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice, with offices throughout the US, focuses on serving the middle market and large cap private equity firms who have engaged A&M to help improve operating results at their portfolio companies. 
Our professionals are aligned with a PEPI service line to promote the development of deep functional skills & experiences and to maximize our ability to tailor solutions to solve our clients' business issues. 
Our PEPI services include:
Supply Chain
Transformation Services
Manufacturing Operations Improvement
Interim Management
M&A Services
CFO Services
A&M’s Supply Chain professionals assist our clients in analyzing each part of the supply chain process including Strategic Sourcing and Procurement, Logistics and Distribution, Integrated Demand and Supply Planning to identify value creation opportunities, develop a roadmap to accelerate those opportunities and assist with driving them to our client’s bottom line. From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of the supply chain, identify key risks to investment and quantify potential EBITDA improvement plans. 
The PEPI Supply Chain group is a growing business with high growth projected throughout the next two to four years. We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and build leadership skills. The leadership team is focused on providing development opportunities, training and exposure to international and domestic business assignments.
How You Will Contribute 
We are seeking individuals that can lead and deliver project work streams for complex client engagements working closely with Private Equity teams to identify, design, and implement creative business solutions for their portfolio companies. 
Associates support the following types of workstreams and may be asked to conduct analysis as well as execute with team members to deliver results:
- Gain a comprehensive understanding of a client’s procurement organization and strategic sourcing capabilities
- Assist in the development and implementation of sourcing strategies to meet growth and financial objectives through effective integration with forecasting, demand/supply planning, inventory management, and distribution & logistics
- Assist in developing and managing efforts in sourcing and procurement
- Lead supplier identification, approval, contract/pricing negotiations and vendor relations
- Develop implementation plans to drive proposed changes in procurement and sourcing initiatives
- Conduct analysis depending on project scope.
Professional skills:
- Strong written, oral, and analytical skills
- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
- Structured project management (time, team and work-stream management)
- Initiative and drive
- Critical thinking skills
- Ability to deliver time-pressured projects on-time and on-quality
- Flexible and creative thinking
- Client relationship building
- Excellent presentation skills
Qualifications:
- 2-4 plus years of consulting or industry experience
- Previous advisory experience from a top-tier strategy firm or Big-4 consultancy REQUIRED
- Preference for industry roles within Sourcing and Procurement functions
- Industry experience in direct and/or indirect categories
- Bachelor’s degree required in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or related fields
- MBA/Master’s degree preferred
- Experience managing direct and / or indirect categories
- Demonstrated track record of leading sustainable high-impact strategic sourcing approaches
- Exemplary experience designing end-to-end procurement strategies
- Excellent fact-gathering and analytical skills, including business process mapping and quantitative analysis
- Flexibility to travel up to 80% of the time
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
The salary range is $90,000--$130,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.
Full-time Positions and Part-time Positions Over 30 hours
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined from time to time as well as a 401(k) retirement plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive a discretionary contribution to their 401(k) from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.
Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.
A&M does not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

As an Enterprise Technology & AI Transformation Senior Consultant at Capgemini Invent, you will support clients across industries in the design and delivery of complex enterprise transformations, combining technology strategy, operating model design, process optimization, data and AI capabilities, and transformation governance. Join us to help organizations redesign how they operate, make decisions and deliver outcomes—enabled by data, AI and modern technology
In this role, you will be a key player in the following activities:
• Assess enterprise technology landscapes, operating models, capabilities and processes, identifying transformation priorities, value opportunities and execution risks.
• Define and evolve enterprise and technology Target Operating Models, including governance, organization, processes, decision rights, sourcing, capabilities, performance management and enabling platforms.
• Shape end-to-end transformation strategies, roadmaps and business cases, translating strategic ambition into executable initiatives, milestones, benefits and investment priorities.
• Design AI-enabled business and technology operating models, identifying high-value use cases and defining the capabilities, guardrails, governance and adoption mechanisms required to scale them responsibly.
• Support enterprise architecture, platform modernization, cloud, data and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment between business outcomes, technology choices and delivery models.
• Redesign cross-functional processes and ways of working, leveraging automation, analytics, generative AI and product-oriented delivery models to improve efficiency, quality and customer experience.
• Support SAP-enabled finance transformation initiatives, including process assessment and redesign across Record-to-Report, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling, planning and management reporting.
YOUR PROFILE
• 3–6+ years of experience in technology consulting, enterprise transformation, IT strategy, operating model design, digital transformation, enterprise architecture or complex change programs.
• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data/AI, Management Engineering, Economics or a comparable discipline.
• Solid understanding of enterprise technology domains such as cloud, data platforms, integration, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, software delivery and technology operations.
• Practical knowledge of AI and generative AI concepts, use-case assessment, implementation lifecycle, responsible AI, governance, adoption and value measurement.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, structured communication and the ability to work effectively in international, multi-stakeholder environments.

Exploring the art of the possible with AI by combining domain knowledge and AI expertise to identify opportunities across industries and functions where AI can deliver value and by shaping AI/ML roadmaps, and ideation using use cases aligned with data science and business strategies. 
Accelerating impact with AI by enabling proof of value through prototypes and by translating complex AI concepts into practical solutions that democratise access and maximise business advantage for our clients. 
Scaling AI from lab to live by defining and implementing responsible AI design principles throughout the AI journey and establishing sustainable, resilient, and scalable AI/ML Ops architectures and platforms for integrating AI products and solutions into business processes for real-time decision making.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. About the Job You’re Considering
At Capgemini Invent, our Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team makes AI work at scale by combining data science and engineering with business consulting. We build context-driven analytics and GenAI/agentic systems that reflect how decisions and work actually happen—grounded in semantic layers, strong data foundations, and governance embedded in decision flows. With a builder-advisor (“forward deployed”) mindset, DDT delivers production-ready impact across operations and customer domains, redefining what enterprise AI advisory looks like in practice.
Your Role
As a Senior Life Sciences AI Consultant, you will lead domain-specific workstreams within AI engagements, owning delivery from discovery through use case definition, requirements, and validation planning. You will serve as the primary life sciences domain voice on the team—partnering closely with scientific, quality, and operational stakeholders while translating complex regulatory and business needs into actionable AI solutions. In this role, you will build strong client relationships, drive structured problem-solving, and contribute to both client delivery and broader practice development.
You Will
- Own end-to-end domain workstreams across AI engagements, including discovery, use case definition, and solution shaping
- Build trusted relationships with scientific, quality, and operational client stakeholders, acting as a day-to-day advisor
- Design AI use cases that incorporate GxP validation requirements, auditability, and data integrity standards
- Partner with engineering and data teams to translate life sciences requirements into clear technical specifications
- Lead and contribute to validation planning, including IQ/OQ/PQ approaches, CSV frameworks, and risk assessments for AI solutions in regulated environments
- Develop high-quality, domain-rich deliverables such as use case roadmaps, data requirement documentation, and regulatory impact assessments
- Contribute to internal knowledge development, reusable assets, and broader life sciences AI practice growth
Your Skills + Experience
You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI‑enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI‑augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. jd_text:
CAPGEMINI INVENT
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
Join our AI Strategy team and be part of the future of AI consulting. We are redefining how organisations adopt and scale AI by embedding Generative AI, agentic systems, and copilots into every aspect of how they operate, compete, and create value. 
We are looking for experienced Strategy and AI leaders with strong commercial acumen, individuals who understand AI technologies and can translate them into enterprise-wide transformation. You will lead engagements from strategy through to execution, enabling the shift toward AI-enabled enterprises whilst contributing to the growth of our AI Strategy practice. 
YOUR ROLE
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on solving complex problems. From Agentic AI in risk governance, to AI sovereignty in enterprise architecture, to enabling the AI-empowered workforce of tomorrow, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of what’s next. 
We REDEFINE strategy – You will work with clients to define their ambition for AI, identify high-impact use cases and design prioritisation frameworks that guide investment to ensure AI initiatives are aligned with business goals and built for scale.
We ENABLE business transformation with AI – You will help clients disrupt their business model to embed AI and automation into core business processes to unlock new capabilities, drive efficiency, and deliver measurable impact.
We BUILD scalable AI capability - You will help organisations develop and scale AI across functions, embedding the right skills, tools, governance and culture to enable sustainable adoption. From operating models to talent strategy, we ensure AI becomes a core part of how the business operates.
We DRIVE responsible AI adoption - You will help organisations design and implement robust frameworks to safely and responsibly deploy, monitor and assure AI. We ensure AI is used transparently, securely, and inline with core business values.
We SUPERCHARGE delivery - We leverage the power of AI to accelerate delivery and drive innovation for our clients and our business. As part of this role you will be encouraged to experiment with new AI and automation technologies to build proof of concepts, augment research and automate tasks. 
As part of your role alongside client work you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
- Business Development - Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
- Internal contribution - Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
- Learning & development - Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.
YOUR PROFILE
As a member of the Data & AI Strategy Team, you’ll be part of shaping the future of AI consulting. You’ll help organisations unlock value from AI by combining strategic thinking, technology understanding, and delivery experience. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you’ll define AI opportunities, shape practical strategies, and support implementation to drive real outcomes.
Key skills:
Growth mindset & AI curiosity – Actively explore emerging technologies (especially GenAI and agentic systems) and apply them to solve real business challenges.
Strategic problem solving – Structure complex, ambiguous problems and develop clear, actionable AI strategies and roadmaps aligned to business goals.
Communication & stakeholder engagement – Confident working with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
Data & AI expertise – Strong understanding of data ecosystems and AI capabilities (e.g. ML, GenAI, analytics), with the ability to connect technology to tangible business value.
AI strategy & delivery experience – Experience across the lifecycle from discovery and use case definition through to delivery and implementation support.
Capability building & responsible AI – Experience developing AI capabilities (operating models, readiness, training) alongside awareness of AI ethics, risk, and governance.
Technology & delivery experience:
Understanding of GenAI, LLMs, and agentic systems, and their practical application
Workshop design and facilitation to drive ideation and alignment
Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills
Delivery of high-quality outputs (e.g. strategies, business cases, prototypes)
Awareness of end-to-end delivery, linking strategy through to execution
Senior Consultants:
Bring proven experience delivering AI strategy and transformation projects, with the ability to own workstreams, engage clients independently, and bridge strategy and delivery to drive measurable outcomes.
WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE? 
Our team drives business transformation by designing the organisations of the future, delivering end-to-end blueprint for AI-enabled enterprises. We are at the cutting edge of the 4th industrial revolution and are uniquely placed to leverage the broad, market-leading capabilities of Capgemini Group.  
We work across a wide range of industries, delivering outcomes that make a real impact on society. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, innovate and shape your own career path, supported by mentoring from our leading experts in data and AI.  
We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years. To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. 
NEED TO KNOW 
At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self At Cap to work. 
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 
Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 
Please opt in during the application process.

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. Support Federal clients across the full spectrum of financial management, including federal grants, reimbursable agreements, procurement processes, and budget formulation and execution. - Identify opportunities for process improvement and propose practical recommendations to enhance financial operations and controls.
Client Delivery & Communication:
- Develop clear, well-structured deliverables (presentations, reports, analyses, dashboards) that synthesize complex financial information into actionable insights and recommendations for clients, including visually appealing, high-level summaries of large financial datasets for various levels of stakeholders.

Innovation & Problem Solving:
- Perform research and analysis to identify and obtain needed information, including applicable Federal regulations, policies, best practices, and public financial data sources such as USASpending.gov to investigate financial transaction-level discrepancies.

- Recommend changes to processes, tools, or documentation to solve problems and improve efficiency or compliance, including documenting current data analysis processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and iterating on data displays or communication methods to advance PMO goals.
Leadership & Teamwork:
- Work as part of a team or independently while taking ownership of assigned tasks and workstreams, proactively brainstorming path-forward options and asking targeted questions when guidance is needed.
- Follow established methodologies, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.
- Assist on large to mid-sized, moderately complex projects or task orders, including coordinating specific activities or deliverables.
Organization Impact & Stakeholder Management:
- Contribute to achieving project deadlines, quality expectations, and client satisfaction.
- Collaborate effectively with project team members, internal support functions, and client stakeholders to drive progress and resolve issues.

- Knowledge of Federal financial management regulations and guidance (for example, the Digital Accountability and Transparency Act (DATA Act), Treasury Financial Manual, Federal Financial Management Improvement Act (FFMIA), OMB Circular A 123, and Federal budget process).

- Experience performing or supporting internal control assessments or related risk and control activities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and the Google Productivity Suite to create presentations, communications, and to manipulate and analyze large datasets, create and iterate formulas, and use PivotTables.

- Professional judgment and written communication skills to manage updates, outreach, and technical assistance through a government group inbox.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly present findings and recommendations.
- This hybrid position role may require up to 2-5 days on-site at the client's or Guidehouse office.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace Suite.

Your role:
As Copilot Strategy, Change & Adoption Consultant you will help our clients set the strategic direction for Microsoft Copilot in the workplace, and then make it land. You will pair technology strategy with the change, communications and adoption craft needed to turn Copilot licences into everyday productivity and a genuinely AI-enabled workforce. In this role you will play a key part in:
- Setting the Copilot adoption strategy: Shaping a clear strategic vision for Microsoft Copilot - spanning Microsoft 365 opilot, Copilot Chat, Agent Builder, Copilot Studio and emerging workplace AI capabilities such as Cowork and Scout - aligned to security, data and automation capabilities.
- Driving adoption: Designing and delivering user-centric change and adoption campaigns at scale that tackle AI scepticism, build capability and embed new ways of working.
- Leading complex engagements: Owning delivery excellence on Copilot strategy and adoption workstreams, escalating and de-risking complex situations as the technology evolves.
- Growing the practice: Helping develop the Copilot portfolio and client relationships to generate new opportunities and revenue, and coaching colleagues towards high performance and a positive culture.
As part of your role, you will also be expected to drive the following activities:
Client Advisory and Delivery
- Strategy and Vision: Develop AI workforce transformation strategies, advising senior stakeholders on Microsoft Copilot capabilities, adoption strategy across workforce groups and business functions, business change requirements, and opportunities to create value through AI-enabled ways of working.
- Ways of working Reinvention: Lead work redesign initiatives that leverage AI to enhance productivity, employee experience and organisational outcomes through future-state practices, AI-enabled workflows and effective human-AI collaboration. Facilitate workshops to understand current and future ways of working.
- Change and Adoption: Lead organisational change and adoption programmes from pilot-to-scale that enable successful Copilot deployment through communications, training, engagement, leadership alignment and persona-led adoption plans. Tackle AI scepticism and respond to concerns to increase trust.
- Enablement and Community: Stand up champions networks, training curricula, prompt libraries and enablement assets that sustain adoption as the Copilot estate and feature set evolve. Be innovative!
- Benefit Realisation: Lead value realisation activities for Copilot programmes, creating measurement frameworks, defining success indicators and helping clients translate adoption and productivity gains into tangible business outcomes.
- Senior Stakeholder Engagement: Lead executive engagement and value communications activities, helping senior stakeholders communicate the vision for AI, demonstrate outcomes and align business and technology leaders around Copilot adoption.
In summary you will be required to:
1. Lead client workshops and transformation workstreams.
2. Manage small consulting teams and workstreams.
3. Develop high-quality client deliverables and recommendations.
4. Facilitate discussions with business, technology and change stakeholders.
5. Translate complex AI concepts into practical business outcomes.
6. Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.
Capability Development

- Contribute to inventing new frameworks that map the benefits, adoption and productivity metrics of Microsoft AI technology to business outcomes, continuously strengthening the AI business case.
- Drive experimentation on Copilot adoption approaches to explore new ways to serve our clients and stay at the forefront of innovation.
- Identify opportunities to accelerate your team’s upskilling in Copilot, investing in new training and certifications to keep pace with the technology.
- Stay informed of the competitive technology landscape and assess the feasibility of deploying Generative and Agentic AI solutions such as Microsoft Copilot.
Business Development
- Support responses to bids, RFPs, RFIs and proposals, embedding the required governance to meet deadlines and quality.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across Capgemini to understand client needs and shape new deals with expert solutions.
- Drive solution development, including input into staffing, skill requirements and functional ideation across the delivery lifecycle.
Your profile:
Capgemini Invent DNA
- Highly collaborative, able to expand your network within Capgemini to promote the Workplace AI offerings whilst advocating for other teams’ capabilities to your clients.
- A passion for continuous learning and a willingness to develop those around you – both clients and colleagues.
- Drive performance and continuous improvement, inspiring and celebrating a culture of boldness.
Leadership
- Getting buy-in and aligning senior business and technical leaders on the benefits of AI technology, using strong communication, presentation and analytical skills.
- Ability to build, grow and coach cross-functional teams, driving cohesion and contributing to the wellbeing of your people.
- Upholding strong ethical values, consistently making the conscious choice to ‘do the right thing’ in business and in leading your team.
Business and Methods
- Ability to shape and convey compelling storytelling around our Workplace AI offers and the business value on offer.
- Proven experience designing and delivering change, communications and adoption at scale, with tangible behavioural results.
- Proven experience applying strategy and innovation approaches to solve complex, analytical and technical business problems.
- Strong project management skills, well-versed in agile principles, and confident managing timelines, budgets and resources.
Technical
- Working understanding of Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Chat), first-party agents and Agent Builder, and the wider Microsoft AI stack or Anthropic stack, sufficient to build credibility with senior client stakeholders.

We are looking for individuals who combine analytical and technical capability, consulting skills and a passion for using data and AI to solve real business problems.

Ability to translate business challenges and user needs into practical data and AI solutions.

Prompt engineering, AI evaluation and Responsible AI 
AI orchestration frameworks e.g. LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP) 
Data engineering, pipelines, modelling and governance 
Advanced analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling 
Data visualisation and insight solutions 
Candidates should understand the importance of trusted, accessible and AI-ready data, and be curious about how AI can be embedded into business processes and decision-making.

Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: 
Programming & Analytics – Python, SQL, R, Spark, machine learning and advanced analytics 
Cloud & Data Platforms – Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS and GCP 
AI Technologies – GenAI frameworks, Agentic AI, vector databases, semantic search, knowledge retrieval and LLM application development 
Data & Visualisation – Power BI, Tableau, Looker and other business intelligence tools

Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. 
Strong communication, problem-solving and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
Ownership of the quality and timely delivery of your work. 
Collaborative, inclusive and adaptable working style. 
Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and ways of working.

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. Your Role
As a Business Technology Consultant, you will support clients in navigating complex technological transformations and shaping the future of their IT organizations. You will work on high-impact projects, advising senior management of international clients on strategic and transformational topics such as IT strategy, operating model design, IT performance and cost optimization, enterprise architecture, and cloud business transformation (including FinOps). You will also play a role in scaling Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions across organizations.
Your tasks
- Work on exciting projects, tackle complex challenges, and help our clients shape the future of their IT and technology organizations.
- Advise senior management of international clients across industries, focusing on strategic and transformational topics such as: IT Strategy, Operating Model & Performance (including IT cost optimization), Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Business Transformation (including FinOps), Scaling Generative AI and Agentic AI.
- Identify innovative strategies and optimize IT processes and technology landscapes,
- Develop tailored solutions aligned with clients’ digital agendas,
- Contribute to strengthening clients’ business strategies through cutting-edge IT concepts and target operating models.
Your profile
- Strong experience in IT/technology project management, with proven ability to deliver complex initiatives
- Subject matter expertise in at least one area: IT Strategy & Operating Model, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Transformation & FinOps, or Generative & Agentic AI at scale
- Passion for digital transformation and emerging technologies, with a forward-thinking mindset
- Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a proactive, reliable, and learning-oriented attitude
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence in working with senior leadership and cross-functional teams
- Strong academic background in business, technology, or information systems, with very good command of English (written and spoken)
- Flexibility and willingness to travel, with additional assets such as project management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, SAFe) and German or French language skills
- Experience in industry-specific environments (e.g., Financial Services) and exposure to IT cost optimization and efficiency initiatives
What You'll love about working here
- Well-being culture: medical care with Medicover, private life insurance, and Sports card. But we went one step further by creating our own Capgemini Helpline offering therapeutical support if needed and the educational podcast 'Let's talk about wellbeing' which you can listen to on Spotify.
- Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Excel, Business Analysis, Project Management) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First languages platform, Pluralsight, TED Talks, Coursera and Udemy Business materials and trainings.
- Continuous feedback and ongoing performance discussions thanks to our performance management tool GetSuccess supported by a transparent performance management policy.
- Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details.
Get to know us
Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued.
Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube.

With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations.  About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
The firm is seeking to expand its Private Equity Performance Improvement (PEPI) -Technology Industry Group team. With more than 10,000 professionals across six continents, A&M draws on a strong operational heritage and a hands-on approach. Our professionals work closely with organizations and stakeholders to address complex business challenges and maximize value. Technology Industry Group is a growing business targeting high growth in the next 2-4 years.
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice, with offices throughout the US, focuses on serving upper middle market and large cap private equity firms who have engaged A&M to help improve operating results at their portfolio companies. The companies we assess are in the upper middle market 50 million to 1 billion plus range.
How you will contribute 
Our Technology Industry Group offering brings a structured and disciplined approach to create and capture value. We provide corporate and equity buyers with a broad continuum of knowledge and tools for performance management, mergers, acquisitions, carve-outs, joint ventures and alliances. 
The team works across the full spectrum of the deal and company lifecycle from pre-deal technology, operational and synergy reviews, through 'Day-1' planning, to post-deal implementations, and performance improvement. Our projects often include evaluation of, or initiatives related to product and technology functions across the deal and company lifecycle, which requires an understanding of the product roadmap and portfolio, architecture, and SDLC processes.
Engagement types and responsibilities include:
- Assess product strategy, roadmap, and portfolio mix to ensure alignment with business objectives and market opportunities. This includes identifying gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for rationalization or expansion.
- Complete product feature parity assessments and develop recommended product integration strategy for M&A activity for competitor companies
- Assess product team structures, roles, and interaction models to evaluate collaboration, agility, and accountability, and recommend improvements for scaling and efficiency.
- Evaluate KPIs, OKRs, and analytics frameworks that measure product success, customer impact, and ROI. Examine decision making processes to see if they are data-driven and tied to measurable outcomes.
- Evaluate and/or conduct market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and customer feedback reviews to validate product-market fit and identify innovation opportunities. Evaluate offerings to determine differentiation and alignment with user/market needs.
We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and leadership development. Our leadership team provides career growth, training, and exposure to international business assignments.
Build your skillset by providing valuable insight into how an entire business goes through the change process. And as we help our technology focused PE and corporate clients outperform the market, you will add real value too. All the while, you can broaden your technology experience across the TIG industry groups and enjoy unlimited opportunities to progress as part of a fast-growing team.
Qualifications
- 3–5+ years in roles such as Product Manager, Group Product Manager, Director of Product, or R&D Strategy/Operations Lead preferably in mid to large software, semiconductor company
- Exposure to private equity sponsors, portfolio companies, or related transaction / merger integration is a bonus
- Proven experience in building or evaluating product roadmaps, prioritizing features, and aligning engineering spend with strategic goals. Experience contributing to or leading R&D or product assessments, whether internally (e.g., roadmap rationalization, OKR planning) or externally (e.g., vendor evaluations, M&A integration planning
- Strong understanding of cross-functional teamwork required to deliver high-quality features on time and within scope
- Strong system design acumen, with experience leading and evaluating technical and product interviews
- Hands-on knowledge of modern cloud architecture, including containerization, event-driven systems, streaming data pipelines, and distributed data stores
- Ability to analyze R&D spend patterns (headcount, vendor costs, cloud spend, tooling, etc.) and link them to innovation or revenue outcomes.
- Familiarity with Agile SDLC, DevOps practices, and tooling (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, SAST/DAST)
- Deep functional expertise in one or more of the following areas is a bonus:
- Product or Technical Program Management, CTO advisory, or strategic engineering leadership
- R&D merger integration and carve-out including Business / IT transformation program / project management (e.g., ERP)
- Understanding of SaaS business models, including ARR growth levers, customer adoption metrics, and product-led growth strategies
- Product strategy and performance improvement, including cost-reduction initiatives
- Private Equity Advisory around Product and R&D functions
- Comfortable engaging with senior R&D leadership and clearly articulating technical findings to executive and private equity stakeholders
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field experience; MBA preferred
- Team-oriented, adaptable, curious, and quick learner
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; excellent communication abilities
- Willing to travel up to 25%
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.
The base salary range is $100,000 - $170,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering
As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.
The Process Excellence team helps clients improve how work gets done across core enterprise processes by combining process design, process mining, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled / agentic approaches to drive measurable business outcomes. The work is practical and value-focused: identifying inefficiencies, surfacing root causes through data, redesigning workflows, improving control and performance, and building roadmaps that translate operational pain points into real transformation. It is a strong fit for people who like solving complex business problems in a structured, evidence-based way and who can connect AI, intelligent automation, and process insight to broader enterprise transformation.
Your Role
As a senior consultant you’ll lead process diagnostics and automation workstreams-turning operational pain into an executable plan with a credible value case. This is where you start owning the “so what” and “now what,” not just the analysis - often with GenAI as an accelerant, not a gimmick.
You Will:
· Lead process discovery, mining, and root-cause analysis for client workstreams
· Define target operating model implications and governance for sustained change
· Build and prioritize automation roadmaps based on value and feasibility
· Facilitate workshops, present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders
· Guide adoption of automation and AI-enabled operational improvements
· Coach junior team members and ensure high-quality deliverables
Your Skills + Experience 
You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI‑enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI‑augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.
Required Experience
· 5–8 years in process transformation, automation, or business transformation consulting
· Hands-on exposure to process mining/automation tools and methods
· Strong advisory skills; can influence stakeholders and drive decisions
· Experience with TOM, controls, or governance is a plus
· Experience with process mining and automation tools (i.e. UiPath, Celonis, Signavio, etc.)
· Lean six sigma certification preferred
· Executive-ready communication and strong client presence

ERM is seeking a motivated EHS Consultant who is interested in paticipating a variety of projects covering the full spectrum of ERM’s services. 
ERM delivers a wide range of services, including strategy development aligned with sustainability risks and opportunities, policy/regulatory analysis, peer benchmarking, operating model and organizational readiness, and action planning around core sustainability topics such as climate change/GHG emission reduction and circular economy.
Responsibilities
- Serve as the site EHS focal point, coordinating daily with the client, EPCC contractor, subcontractors and site teams.
- Monitor compliance with applicable Malaysian EHS legislation, project approvals, permit conditions, contractual requirements and approved EHS plans and procedures.
- Conduct routine inspections, joint walkthroughs and scheduled audits across construction areas, worker facilities, equipment, material storage and environmental controls.
- Verify implementation of permit-to-work systems, risk assessments, job safety analyses, toolbox meetings, competency controls, emergency arrangements and incident-reporting procedures.
- Review contractor submissions and records, including method statements, inspection reports, monitoring results, waste documentation, licences, permits, training records and statutory certificates.
- Monitor controls for high-risk activities, including work at height, lifting, excavation, confined-space entry, electrical work, hot work, traffic management, mobile plant and simultaneous operations.
- Monitor environmental controls for erosion and sediment, scheduled wastes, wastewater and effluent, dust, noise, air emissions, chemical storage, spills and sensitive receptors.
- Record observations and non-conformances, agree corrective actions with the EPCC contractor, and verify close-out within the required timeframe.
- Support incident notification, investigation and root-cause analysis, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
- Participate in site coordination and EHS meetings, progress reviews and emergency drills; promptly escalate significant, repeated or overdue issues to client site management.
- Prepare clear daily, weekly and monthly reports covering compliance status, inspection findings, incidents, performance indicators, outstanding actions and emerging risks.
- Liaise with regulatory authorities when authorised by the client and support inspections, submissions and follow-up actions.
- Exercise stop-work authority in accordance with project procedures where there is imminent danger, serious non-compliance or unacceptable environmental risk.
- Maintain complete, current and auditable site EHS records.
Requirements
- Degree or diploma in environmental science, engineering, occupational safety and health, construction management or a related technical discipline.
- Minimum 5 years of site-based EHS experience on construction, infrastructure, industrial or energy projects, including direct coordination with an EPCC or main contractor and subcontractors.
- Proven experience in site inspections, compliance audits, contractor-document reviews, incident investigations and corrective-action close-out.
- Strong working knowledge of Malaysian environmental and occupational safety and health legislation, licences, permits, approval conditions and construction-site compliance requirements.

- Practical knowledge of construction controls, including permit-to-work, risk assessment, lifting, excavation, work at height, confined spaces, hot work, traffic management and emergency response.
- Practical awareness of electrical safety, including temporary installations and distribution boards, isolation and lockout/tagout, energised-work interfaces, earthing, residual-current protection, cable management, portable tools and coordination with authorised electrical personnel.
- Practical knowledge of construction environmental controls, including scheduled wastes, wastewater, erosion and sediment, dust, noise, chemical storage and spill response.

- Ability to prepare concise site reports, meeting records and escalation notes.
- Willing and physically able to work predominantly at site, undertake frequent inspections, wear required personal protective equipment and operate safely within active construction areas.
- Valid driving licence and ability to travel to and within the project site.
- Applicants must submit a project credential sheet stating each relevant assignment’s project type, location, duration, role, EPCC or contractor interface, key responsibilities and associated competency certifications.

Wir verbinden fundierte Datenanalysen mit strategischer Vergütungsberatung und Corporate-Governance-Expertise. So unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Vergütung konsequent an Unternehmensstrategie, nachhaltiger Wertentwicklung und den Erwartungen relevanter Stakeholder auszurichten.
Für diese Einheit suchen wir ab sofort für die Standorte Frankfurt am Main / Köln / München eine(n) 
(Senior) Consultant (m/w/d) Work & Rewards - Executive Compensation & Board Advisory
Was erwartet Dich?
- Mitwirkung an nationalen und internationalen Beratungsprojekten zur Vorstands-, Geschäftsführungs- und Aufsichtsratsvergütung
- Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Vergütungsstrategien und Vergütungssystemen unter Berücksichtigung von Unternehmensstrategie, Kapitalmarktanforderungen, regulatorischen Vorgaben und Corporate Governance
- Durchführung von Vergütungsbenchmarks, Peer-Group-Analysen sowie Markt- und Best-Practice-Studien

- Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unserem internationalen Executive Compensation & Board Advisory Netzwerk

- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen und komplexen Datensätzen
- Interesse an Vergütungsthemen auf Vorstands- und Führungskräfteebene sowie an Corporate-Governance-Fragestellungen
- Sicheres Auftreten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel und PowerPoint
- Hohe Kundenorientierung, Eigeninitiative und Teamfähigkeit
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Work-Life-Balance – Mobiles Arbeiten oder im Büro? Flexible Arbeitszeiten? Klar, kein Problem. Wir entscheiden gemeinsam im Team, wann und wo wir arbeiten. Teammeetings und gemeinsame Brainstormings vor Ort kommen trotzdem nicht zu kurz. Hybrides Arbeiten ist bei uns mehr als ein Buzzword. 
- Attraktive Vergütung & Vorsorge – Ein attraktives,leistungsgerechtes Vergütungssysteminklusive arbeitgeberfinanzierterbetrieblicher Altersversorgung,Absicherung bei Berufsunfähigkeit sowie 30 Tage Urlaub bei Vollzeit. 
- Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland – Die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage am Stück innerhalb von 12 Monaten aus dem europäischen Ausland zu arbeiten. 
- Familienfreundlich – Wir unterstützen unsere Mitarbeitenden und ihre Familien mit einem flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodell. Neben Gleit- und Abbautagen bieten wir 5 arbeitgeberfinanzierte Kinderkranktage. 
- Freistellungen – Wir bieten eine temporäre Vollfreistellung über 2 bis 6Monate (Sabbatical),Vorruhestandsregelungen sowieSonderurlaubstage. 
- Gesundheit & Wellbeing – Mit unserem Employee Assistance Program (EAP) unterstützen wir Mitarbeitende und ihre Familien bei beruflichen und privaten Herausforderungen. Ergänztwird dieses Angebot durch Gesundheitsaktionen, Vorsorgeangeboteund einen Zuschuss zur Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrille. 
- Firmenrad – Ein Fahrradleasing über die Entgeltumwandlung. 
- Internationalität – Eine internationale Unternehmensberatung und die Sicherheit eines globalen Konzerns mit renommierten Kunden, vom DAX-Konzern bis zum weltbekannten Mittelständler.
- Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Einesteile Lernkurve sowie ausreichend Freiraum für die individuelle Karriereentwicklung: Du wirst in vielfältige Themen tief eintauchen, sowohl on-the-job als auch in intensiven Fachtrainings.

jd_text: Role Summary In Accenture Operations, we are looking for a highly motivated Business Transformation Analyst to support clients in designing, implementing, scaling, and optimizing enterprise transformation initiatives across industries. Part of the role will focus on helping clients design, set up, scale, and improve Global Capability Centers (GCCs). At the same time, the role remains broader, meaning that you will work on a broad range of topics related to business transformations. This covers operating model transformation, governance frameworks, service delivery improvements, talent strategies, technology enablement, and transformation roadmaps for our clients, where you will typically work as a business analyst, support in these changes. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, structured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and execution discipline, with an interest in how GCCs, Shared Services, Global Business Services, AI, automation, and analytics can help organizations build scalable capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes. Accenture Operations As part of Accenture Operations, you focus on executing plans efficiently and achieving short-term objectives in line with the strategic goals. Within Operations, we also typically have longer engagements to ensure effective transformations, and the right capacity and capabilities are in place. You will work together with our colleagues from different reinvention partners such as Talent, Digital Core and Industry & Enterprise. While their focus will be on setting up the operating model, our focus on Operations is to work together on implementing and executing the change and ensuring a smooth transformation for clients by achieving operational excellence. You typically work with mid-level management and department heads at the client and make a bridge to their operations through a hands-on approach. Key Responsibilities Transformation Delivery Support the planning and execution of business transformation, enterprise operating model, service delivery improvement, and capability-building initiatives across industries. Support clients in defining and executing GCC-related transformation initiatives, including setup, scale-up, optimization, transition planning, and value realization. Contribute to operating model design activities, including service scope, governance, talent considerations, process ownership, location considerations, and technology enablement. Help shape GCC operating models by supporting capability maps, service portfolios, governance forums, KPIs, SLAs, escalation paths, and decision-making structures. Support maturity assessments, benchmarking studies, business case development, transition planning, and value realization. Support transformation planning across business functions, retained organizations, operational teams, and third-party partners. Develop an understanding of how AI, automation, analytics, process excellence, and digital tools can improve productivity, operational performance, scalability, and business outcomes. Assist in developing transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, milestones, RAID logs, delivery trackers, and value realization updates. Support process documentation, process mapping, and process improvement activities. Analysis & Insights Analyze operating models, organizational structures, service delivery models, governance frameworks, capability structures, and business processes. Develop insights and recommendations supported by qualitative and quantitative analysis. Create reports and presentation materials for client and internal discussions. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with client stakeholders, internal teams, and subject matter experts across business, operations, technology, HR, finance, and transformation functions. Support workshops, meetings, and working sessions to gather requirements and structure discussions Change Management & PMO Support change management and adoption activities linked to new processes, tools, roles, service delivery models, and ways of working. Track progress against milestones, KPIs, value realization metrics, transition deliverables, and agreed transformation outcomes. Support project management activities including planning, reporting, dependency management, issue resolution, resource coordination, and status updates.

Who We Are
FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
Are you ready to make your impact?

In Business Transformation at FTI Consulting, we focus on our clients’ strategic, operational, financial and capital needs by addressing the full spectrum of financial and transactional challenges faced by corporations, boards, private equity sponsors, creditor constituencies and other stakeholders.
