jd_text:
Description 
 Company Overview
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
A&M Debt Advisory supports Private Equity, Infrastructure Funds and Corporate clients through the economic cycle, providing high value-add advice on debt raising, capital structure optimisation and navigating challenging situations. Our deep relationships across the lender community enable clients to access a broad range of liquidity pools.
The Team
Our team includes highly respected ex-bankers and advisors with many years of expertise across the credit spectrum, working both with experienced borrowers and those approaching the debt markets for the first time. Members of the team have worked on transactions across all different types of borrowing instruments in both the private and public capital markets.
Advice extends from optimising capital structures and reviewing financing options through to planning and execution including identifying potential lenders and investors, presenting the credit story and negotiating optimal terms for clients.
How you will contribute
Our French team is highly active across EMEA working for global and regional private equity firms, multinational corporations and family offices and we are looking for a talented and ambitious Analyst with an advisory or banking background to join our growing team in Paris.
Typical projects will include:
- Supporting Private Equity, Corporate, Infrastructure investors and Family Office clients in funding acquisitions, refinancings and recapitalisations
- Reviewing refinancing options to support growth strategies
- Advising on optimal capital structures
- Providing assistance on refinancing and amending existing debt facilities
- Assisting borrowers with managing their relationships with debt providers and raising new money
- Carrying out financial modelling, including analysing business forecasts, scenario analysis and covenant sensitivities
Qualifications
- Experience in debt markets from a role in debt advisory, leveraged finance, structured finance or corporate lending (including ABL) is advantageous, but a strong candidate without direct debt market experience would be considered
- Strong academic background including a highly numerate skill set and experience in key relevant skill areas (e.g. credit analysis and financial modelling)
- A keen desire to learn and develop in a meritocratic environment
- Well-developed communication skills and the ability to work with diverse and complex stakeholder groups
- Previous experience in contributing to project workstreams ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables with minimal supervision
- The team is making increasing use of AI in a structured manner to improve the quality of its client service and experience with efficient and compliant use of these systems could be an advantage
- Fluent business level English & French is essential. Additional language skills including European languages and Arabic are advantageous
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
Culture & Values
At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.
Equal Opportunity Employer
It is Alvarez & Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A&M policy statements and additional information by region here.
Unsolicited Resumes from Third-Party Recruiters
Please note that as per A&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

jd_text:
Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
The Opportunity
Arup’s business and technology consulting teams create high-quality, innovative digital solutions for our clients. As a Senior Business Analyst Consultant, you will work in multidisciplinary teams to define problems and opportunities, identify needs and requirements, and examine options for digital solutions that transform our clients’ operations.
Our consultants combine technology expertise with in-depth market knowledge across Sustainable Transport, Clean Energy, Water, Property, and Science, Industry and Technology Infrastructure. Client satisfaction and high-quality delivery are central to our work, reflected in our repeat business, testimonials and awards.
You will work on a variety of consulting assignments related to digital strategy development and execution. The role will involve:
- Assessing the client’s current situation or challenge
- Eliciting drivers, requirements and constraints for change
- Formulating transformation roadmaps through digital change
- Supporting implementation and roll-out to enterprises and users
- Assuring that digital solutions meet business requirements and deliver measurable outcomes
Typical assignments may involve collaboration with our core engineering and advisory services. They may include shaping digital and data strategies, defining innovative digital products and services, enabling AI and analytics capabilities, improving asset management and operational processes, supporting digital twin initiatives, and helping organisations navigate complex digital transformation challenges.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. 
You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. 
Is this role right for you? 
We’re looking for a candidate who:
- Has a qualification in a subject related to information technology and/or certifications from recognised bodies or major vendors, such as BCS (British Computer Society) or The Open Group
- Has achieved, or is working towards, chartered status as an engineer or IT professional
- Has experience in an IT delivery, IT consulting or equivalent environment
- Has experience applying business analysis techniques and working within digital architecture frameworks to design and implement digital products and services
- Has experience in one or more of the following markets: Energy, Water, Rail, Roads and Streets, or Aviation
- Holds a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) or SC (Security Check) security clearance, or are able to obtain it
Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact Marek Mazurowski (marek.mazurowski@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
***Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application and for the duration of employment. Any offer made will be subject to satisfactory proof of immigration status.***
What we offer you
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. 
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.
Different People, Shared Values
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence. 
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. 
Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup/.
We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Marek Mazurowski (marek.mazurowski@arup.com) to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.
Our Application Process
To understand what to expect next, please visit our https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/. 
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.
Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.
Closing date: 8th November 2026
We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

jd_text:
Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Milan. 
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world. 
Our award-winning Business and Investor Advisory (BIA) team is a market leader in infrastructure and energy advisory services. We're looking for infrastructure and energy engineering graduates passionate about strategy and investments.
We work across international markets, providing strategic, and technical advice throughout the project lifecycle. With expertise spanning energy, transport, social infrastructure, and utilities, our work supports investors, asset owners, operators, governments, and financial institutions.
The Opportunity
You will be working on individual projects, typically comprising technical and environmental, social and governance (ESG) due diligence to inform lenders, buyers or sellers of infrastructure and energy projects. The focus of the technical due diligence work is to assist in the evaluation of potential investments by identifying and assessing technical, operational, commercial and reputational risks and opportunities.
The successful candidate will be responsible for providing a range of quantitative skills, from data handling and presentation to financial/economic modelling.
We are looking for team members who will support the organic growth of the group and the expansion of our activities in the coming years. This provides opportunities for professional growth and rewards individual proactivity.
The role will also extend to carrying out wider advisory work in the public and private sectors, as appropriate to the individual's skills.
As an Infrastructure Investment Consultant at Arup, you will:
- Assist with project management tasks, with increasing responsibility over time.
- Conduct research and analysis, contributing directly to key project insights.
- Build deep sector expertise through hands-on experience and structured learning.
- Support client-facing tasks, working towards client interaction.
- Work on process improvement and development.
- Collaborate with teams both in Italy and internationally, working closely with technical experts and collaborating with colleagues based in other offices across global projects.
Does this role inspire you?
We're looking for graduates who are passionate about energy, transport, industry and technology markets. We also value:
- A relevant engineering degree, or equivalent experience with infrastructure projects including transport (highways, rails, metro, airports, smart and low emission mobility), social infrastructures (hospitals, schools), utilities and data centres.
- 0 to 3 years of post-graduation experience and track record in commercial or transaction due diligences in the infrastructure sector.
- Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
- Strong knowledge of both Excel and PowerPoint.
- You are fluent in Italian and both written and spoken English.
- Team player, good under delivery pressure whilst maintain quality outputs.
- Ability to rapidly switch from infrastructure-related projects in different fields.
Why Arup? 
At Arup, we believe in investing in our people and supporting their growth from day one. As a trust-owned company, we're driven by our purpose and values, creating a collaborative and rewarding environment for our employees.
Benefits that work for you:
- Professional Growth & Development: Kickstart your career with our structured graduate development program, benefit from continuous learning opportunities, and receive guidance from experienced mentors.
- Global Opportunities: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short-term or long-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.
- Financial Well-being & Ownership: Receive a competitive graduate salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit-sharing program.
In Italy, the gross annual salary (RAL) for this role is €29,500 to €34,000, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the CCNL Terziario (Confcommercio). The final salary is determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria, reflecting experience, qualifications and role-relevant skills. 
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You'll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.
We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. If you need any assistance or adjustments, please visit our Candidate Support page for contact information and assistance. We're happy to help.

Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. 
Our Economics and Casemaking practice sits within the Cities, Planning and Design (CPD) team and is at the forefront of thinking about the future of places. We work with clients to understand the economic, social and spatial value of places, helping them articulate compelling stories, build robust cases for investment, and deliver inclusive and sustainable growth.
Watch this short clip to discover how Arup are shaping a better world and how you could be a part of it!
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Consultant to join our Economics & Casemaking team in Leeds, part of a national practice working at the forefront of shaping cities and places.
You’ll support a wide range of projects across regeneration, economic development, infrastructure and growth, helping clients build compelling cases for investment, develop strategies for inclusive and sustainable growth, and deliver complex programmes. This includes contributing to business cases, strategy and vision documents, socio‑economic analysis, impact assessments and social value work.
Working as part of collaborative, multidisciplinary project teams, you’ll engage with public sector clients, developers and other stakeholders, providing clear, evidence‑based advice in dynamic and often long‑term environments. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Arup, including planners, designers, transport and sustainability specialists.
You don’t need experience in every area. We’re an inclusive team and welcome applicants with a strong interest in cities, regions and the built environment, who are keen to learn, grow and make a positive impact from day one.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
Is this role right for you?
We’re looking for someone who is curious, motivated and enjoys working collaboratively. You’ll bring:
- A degree (or working towards one) in economics, geography, regeneration, real estate, public or social policy, business, town planning or a related built‑environment discipline
- Strong written communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to produce clear, engaging reports and presentations
- Confidence communicating verbally, including contributing to meetings, workshops and presentations
- Analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret data and synthesise information
- A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working as part of a team
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage time and priorities effectively
- A genuine interest in the built environment, including urban regeneration, housing, transport, net zero and related current affairs
Experience with tools such as GIS, PowerBI, economic modelling or Better Business Case training is welcomed but not essential.
This role does not meet the criteria for visa sponsorship under the UK immigration system. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. 
Not ready to apply just yet or have some questions? Contact Drina Zupanovic at Drina.Zupanovicgerard@arup.com - Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
 What we offer you
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.
Different people, shared values
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

Please contact Drina.Zupanovicgerard@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Senior Consultant – Strategy, Transformation & Business Cases
Transport, Mobility & Infrastructure Sector
About Arup
Arup is a global collective of designers, engineers, consultants and technical specialists working together to create a more sustainable future.
Our team in Spain is growing its strategy and transformation consulting capability to support public and private sector clients in addressing complex challenges across mobility, infrastructure and public services.
We are looking for an experienced consultant to play a key role in delivering high-impact advisory projects, leading workstreams, supporting clients through strategic decision-making and helping shape the growth of our consulting business.
The Opportunity
This role is ideal for someone with a background in management consulting, strategy, transformation or programme advisory who enjoys solving complex problems, working across disciplines and translating analysis into actionable recommendations.
The successful candidate will work on complex consulting assignments for transport operators, mobility providers, infrastructure owners, public authorities and government agencies. Projects typically involve strategic planning, business case development, organisational and operational transformation, programme governance, investment decision-making and implementation planning.
This is a hands-on consulting role. We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with a strong delivery mindset and is comfortable moving between executive discussions and detailed project execution.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Transformation
· Support clients (transport/mobility sector) in addressing strategic, operational and organisational challenges.
· Develop strategic assessments, transformation roadmaps and implementation plans.
· Design future operating models and support organisational change initiatives.
· Facilitate workshops, stakeholder engagement activities and strategic discussions.
· Translate complex challenges into structured recommendations and actionable programmes.
Business Cases & Investment Decisions
· Develop business cases and option assessments for major programmes and initiatives.
· Evaluate strategic, operational and delivery implications of investment decisions.
· Support the prioritisation, sequencing and definition of transformation programmes.
· Integrate technical, operational and commercial considerations into decision-making frameworks.
Project Delivery
· Lead consulting workstreams with a high degree of autonomy.
· Coordinate inputs from multidisciplinary teams across different technical disciplines.
· Manage project planning, quality assurance and stakeholder engagement activities.
· Support the delivery of high-quality reports, presentations and client-facing outputs.
Team & Business Growth
- Coach and mentor junior consultants.
- Review and oversee analytical work and deliverables.
- Support proposal development and business development activities.

jd_text:
Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
The water sector is undergoing unprecedented change. Climate risks, population growth, ageing infrastructure, environmental ambition and sector reform are creating some of the most complex challenges the industry has ever faced. Our clients are looking for new ways to plan, invest and adapt, and Arup is helping shape that future.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a junior consultant to join our dynamic and growing team, in one of our offices in Bristol, Cardiff and Birmingham, who is excited by the challenge of driving innovation, delivering excellence for our clients, influencing the sector both nationally and internationally through our projects and thought leadership, and working in collaborative, diverse teams. We combine policy, strategy, economics, engineering and asset management expertise to help clients make better long-term decisions. Our work influences national policy, investment decisions and operational strategies across the water sector.
The Mid-West Strategic Water Services team provides expertise in:
- Policy, regulation and governance;
- Strategy and planning, including long-term strategies, adaptive plans, water resources management plans (WRMP), drainage and wastewater management plans (DWMP) and flood risk management strategies;
- Asset management and investment planning
As part of our growing Strategic Water Services team, you will work with leading water companies, regulators, governments and investors to tackle nationally significant challenges and help create more resilient water systems for people and the environment.
You will help us to deliver effective and professional services for a range of varied and high-profile clients, such as Welsh Water, Wessex Water, Northern Ireland Water, Severn Trent Water, The Nature Conservancy, Ofwat, Natural Resources Wales and the Environment Agency. Working as part of a team, your role will be to advise city and infrastructure clients on a range of policy, regulatory, asset management and engineering issues. 
Across the public and private sectors, you will help manage client relationships with public sector agencies, private sector clients, infrastructure operators and other organisations such as regulators.
What you’ll do
Working collaboratively with colleagues across the UK and internationally, you will help deliver strategic advisory services for a range of clients in the water sector. You will contribute to research, analysis, client engagement and project delivery, helping to shape robust and forward-looking solutions.
Your responsibilities are likely to include:
- Shaping water sector strategy, policy and investment decisions.
- Supporting clients on climate resilience, water security and infrastructure challenges.
- Analysing data and evidence to develop strategic recommendations.
- Engaging water companies, regulators, governments and stakeholders.
- Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated solutions.
- Supporting project delivery, business development and client relationships.
- Contributing to thought leadership and industry best practice.
- Developing expertise through training, mentoring and varied projects.
What we’re looking for
- Degree in Engineering, Economics, Geography, Environmental Science, Mathematics, Water Science, Public Policy, Asset Management or related field; Master's/PhD desirable. 
- Experience in water, regulation, engineering, asset management, investment planning, strategy or a related field. 
- Knowledge or strong interest in water regulation, business planning, price reviews, performance frameworks, asset management and investment planning. 
- Interest in climate resilience, environmental improvement, water security, affordability and long-term sustainability. 
- Understanding of, or willingness to learn, the water sector’s regulatory and policy environment. 
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and strategic thinking skills. 
- Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills. 
- Ability to work across engineering, economics, policy, regulation and sustainability, with curiosity, initiative and strong organisation.
Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
What we offer you
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all our members can belong, grow and thrive through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.
Different people, shared values
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup
We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact maria.mindrut@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.
Our Application Process

Since 2009, Sattva has been working with foundations, philanthropists, companies, non-profits, multi-laterals and impact ecosystems across India, Africa, and Asia, on a collective mission to develop scalable impact solutions for a sustainable world. Sattva is driven by impact and powered by knowledge, always striving to bring the right balance of head-heart-hands to its work. We at Sattva believe that age-old problems need new-age thinking and rigorous implementation, with empathy at the core. And, that’s what we deliver through our end-to-end support capabilities covering research, strategy consulting, programme management, impact assessment and more, to maximise social return on every investment.

About the Team 
Foundations team collaborates with a network of global philanthropic foundations, alongside multilateral aid agencies, aiming to inform, influence, and profoundly impact social and environmental outcomes resulting from their investments in diverse sectors such as education, child development, gender, health, and more. Our primary focus is on catalysing ecosystem transformation by rigorously solving problems, formulating strategic solutions which are logically sound, effective on the ground and ensuring all stakeholders are effectively engaged while their interests are covered.

The Opportunity

Problem Solving

Bring rigour and curiosity, following due process to solve simple problems or parts of a complex problem

Conduct primary and secondary research to arrive at the insights needed to solve the problem

Distinguishes between relevant and irrelevant pieces of information while presenting the problem, approach and solution to key stakeholders

Stakeholder Engagement

Ensure proactive and regular communication with relevant stakeholders

2-4 years of experience in consulting, research, project management, stakeholder management in corporate, social enterprises, consulting firms or global foundations

Position: Research Analyst, Cybersecurity
Department: Growth Opportunity Analytics
Employment type: Full-Time
Location: Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia

Location: Selangor or Iskandar, Johor

The Opportunity

The Security division of Frost & Sullivan provides organisations with up-to-date market intelligence that enables our clients to take advantage of the rapid pace of technology and business model evolution in global markets. Every company around the globe is impacted by Security challenges; when combined with the power of Frost & Sullivan’s vertical market practices, the Asia-Pacific Security team provides clients with differentiated market intelligence that delivers both vendor and end-user insights.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for Market Research Analyst professional to play a key role in the growth of the cybersecurity market research and consulting team in APAC. This is a thought leadership position that requires the candidate to help build our business practice by developing insightful strategic research and proactively supporting client engagements, business development, and team building initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Expertise– Become a core member of the cybersecurity market research team, delivering value via strategic research, client engagement, and social media outreach.

Intellectual Property and Strategic Evaluation –
Develop powerful, actionable strategic recommendations, and insightful, up-to-date market intelligence based on a profound understanding of the cybersecurity industry, technologies, and services that security vendors sell into the enterprise market.

Business Development –
Maintain strong business relationships via proactive outreach to security vendors across APAC, regularly participate in briefings with security vendors, conduct detailed business needs analysis for Frost & Sullivan clients, and ensure the translation of client strategic business needs into one or more Frost & Sullivan research solutions.

Consulting Engagement – Contribute to cybersecurity consulting projects and utilise defined market research and analytical practices in a team-focused environment.

Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate and an enthusiastic curiosity about the critical role cybersecurity plays in enabling businesses in every industry across APAC. A proactive, methodical, and innovative – thinking outside the box – working practice is essential, with the ability to deliver accurate, high impact results in a fast-paced team-focused environment.

Essential

An analytical thought process, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills and business level fluency in English.

The organisational skills and ability to develop a coherent story about what is happening in a market.

An understanding of consulting/research/investigative journalism methodologies and business modelling (primary/secondary research, strategy development/implementation/coherent story development, and consulting best practices/processes).

Fast learner who can quickly demonstrate understanding of the Security industry, its structure, operational practices, business functionalities, and competitive landscape.

Desire and enthusiasm to build expertise in the cybersecurity domain.

Ability to proactively forge and maintain security vendor relationships.

Commercially astute enthusiasm for supporting the company’s business development initiatives

Aspiration to become a public speaker with the ability to interactively present to an executive audience and defend the research and its conclusions in a professional manner.

A team player with a deep understanding about why collaboration is the key to business success, an ability to work across all of Frost & Sullivan’s industry practices in a collaborative fashion to deliver our unique cross vertical market intelligence and consulting solutions.

A degree level education or equivalent experience within a relevant related discipline, e.g.:

Journalism, business administration, sociology, anthropology, psychology, market research, market intelligence, or consulting.

Desirable

A relevant post graduate qualification (MA, MBA) or equivalent experience, e.g.:

Market intelligence, market research analyst, consulting, or journalism focused on business issues, advisory services, and/or consulting.

Previous experience in a market/industry research role.

Familiar with cybersecurity concept and market landscape, particularly in the areas of cloud/ application, data security and cybersecurity services.

Career Progression

We believe in career progression. We therefore invest in training and career development, with defined career paths available to those who demonstrate higher levels of success.

If you are interested in working in an international, fast paced, dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding team player environment and you meet the requirements of this role, please forward your CV and cover letter outlining your suitability for the position to the email box provided.

Only successful applicants will be contacted for interview.

You must be eligible to work in the Malaysia for any employer.

Frost & Sullivan is an Equal Opportunities employer.
